economy.zh:
过去24小时，全球市场在多重冲击中震荡：中东局势骤紧、油价逼近100美元、特朗普关税再遭诉讼、AI军备竞赛进入新阶段。美股标普500虽勉强收于7412点的纪录高位，但芯片股拖累明显；欧洲股市先跌后涨，ECB继续加码绿色抵押；亚太市场受台风与科技股抛售双重压制。以下为今日关键动态：

- **中东冲突升级**：沙特拦截也门胡塞武装弹道导弹，美军打击伊朗目标，胡塞袭击红海油轮，两艘满载400万桶沙特原油的中国超级油轮试图撤离曼德海峡。油价逼近100美元，市场担忧出现“双瓶颈”危机。[[Saudi military strikes Houthi targets](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/saudi-military-strikes-iran-backed-houthi-targets-yemen.html)] [[Oil prices near $100](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jul/23/andy-burnham-business-rates-pubs-clubs-live-music-vape-shops-european-central-bank-ecb-interest-rates-latest-news-updates)]

- **特朗普关税再起波澜**：新一批关税生效数小时即被起诉，专家质疑其法律依据。25%的巴西进口关税与50%的加拿大关税威胁令贸易伙伴紧张。[[Trump sued hours after new tariffs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html)]

- **AI竞争白热化**：英伟达锁定SK海力士高带宽内存供应（涉及5000亿美元AI交易），同时“蒸馏”技术成为硅谷与华盛顿监管辩论焦点；AI的怀疑论者——福音派、工会、反数据中心活动家——正形成新联盟。[[Nvidia locks down memory](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/nvidia-locks-down-memory-from-sk-hynix-as-part-of-500-billion-ai-deal.html)] [[Distillation obsession](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/hat-is-distillation-and-why-is-everyone-so-obsessed-with-it-this-week.html)] [[AI skeptic coalition](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/trump-ai-data-center-backlash.html)]

- **美联储人事与政策动向**：美联储宣布货币政策工作组领导层与目标，同时发布银行检查中敏感信息处理联合声明，并处罚前Heritage State Bank高管。[[Fed task forces](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)]

- **港股与A股承压**：阿里巴巴、腾讯领跌科技板块，恒指跌至24963点；台风“红霞”登陆华南，广东多机场大面积取消或延误，超34万人撤离。[[Hang Seng Index Falls](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOUl9Oa0xyVklfYk9kNTF5Y1B0Zzk5Qll4TXA5Vkg3SEhZZUxPekNRQndFWnhnQTVMVkRraVlNeVBHMHoteE9MX1kwZTBXRk9TeU9yRXVpaUdjTTJNRVFhLWhQT0xPeVZxMkxDYVFvVlNyWklESWJaRnQ5Q1ZIVzBmOXJTbFV3NXVtdVJ0WFlZUVlBUC1vWkJDTi1DMkZtZkJxSlpQT3dRTVdkVnhQV2wtbmR2a0FreEhJMFZMajQ5cmRUbFZTZG1TamdiSW8)] [[Typhoon Noul](https://news.google.)]

- **欧洲电池危机与零售投资新策**：欧洲面临“搁浅电池产能”危机，同时欧盟零售投资战略旨在鼓励居民入市。[[Europe’s stranded battery capacity crisis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE85QzFZbjB5dFQxaEZKWnphand0QlVjSTJINHB6S0VPT0dGNHBPb2JJOExUazJzTWswWUlHcDNYRGlDdWw0eTlVVjVCSHdlMXJ5Z3ZaU2Fab1dTam0ySkUyT0Y3UzFxT3BJQTgzeF8wbGpiSGRxRlE)] [[Retail Investment Strategy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNbUI0eGRsb1dKOFBZRjBEcHRkSU9ZajZNeFFibUE5NjlTRm93Q2R3ajBiczljM3V4NjVkVXFJLVlJRUlCaWc0MllGQnRhclJIRFh0T3ZyeE1SNTBmbnl3UTFTdjBDUXA5SllLclhrX3B6SWpOa2NCUjF3ejJHSDY1ZWFZVWUxcV9tSmk0SzVGQWpjY2pDRVdlY3U2WWp2d054X2JfUzJVNXFuVkVoNXBvM05kQXE)]

**后续观察**：中东局势若持续升温，油价突破100美元将加大全球通胀压力，考验各国央行下一步利率决策。特朗普关税诉讼可能延缓政策落地，但贸易摩擦风险仍在。AI硬件供应链（尤其是英伟达与SK海力士的合作）可能成为下半年科技股核心主线。中国需关注台风灾后重建对经济活动的短期拖累以及港股流动性变化。
economy.en:
Over the past 24 hours, markets have been pulled in multiple directions by escalating Middle East military action, renewed US tariffs and an immediate legal challenge, a deepening AI infrastructure arms race, and mixed signals from China’s economy. The S&P 500 managed a record close at 7,411.98 despite chip sector weakness, while European benchmarks recovered early losses. In Asia, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng slipped below 25,000 as tech heavyweights retreated, and Typhoon Noul slammed into southern China, forcing mass evacuations and grounding flights.

- **Middle East conflict escalates:** Saudi Arabia intercepted ballistic missiles from Yemen after Iran-backed Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping. Two Chinese supertankers carrying 4 million barrels of Saudi oil are trying to exit the Bab el-Mandeb strait, and oil prices are hovering near $100/barrel. The situation creates a ‘two-chokepoint problem’ that raises energy costs and shipping insurance premiums globally. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/saudi-military-strikes-iran-backed-houthi-targets-yemen.html) | [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jul/23/andy-burnham-business-rates-pubs-clubs-live-music-vape-shops-european-central-bank-ecb-interest-rates-latest-news-updates)
- **Trump tariffs hit legal wall:** Hours after new 25% duties on Brazilian imports and threats of 50% tariffs on Canadian goods took effect, President Trump was sued. Experts question whether the tariffs can hold up under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, introducing fresh uncertainty for trade-exposed sectors. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html)
- **Nvidia locks down critical AI memory supply:** As part of a massive $500 billion AI deal, Nvidia is securing high-bandwidth memory from SK Hynix, underscoring the fierce competition for GPU components. Meanwhile, the concept of AI ‘distillation’ has become a hot regulatory and industry debate. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/nvidia-locks-down-memory-from-sk-hynix-as-part-of-500-billion-ai-deal.html) | [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/hat-is-distillation-and-why-is-everyone-so-obsessed-with-it-this-week.html)
- **ECB advances climate integration and monetary policy review:** The European Central Bank extended the use of climate factors in its collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims and announced the leadership of monetary policy task forces. Chief Economist Philip R. Lane gave an outlook on the euro area economy. Separately, bitcoin is contending with the ECB’s €51.8 billion bond wall, reducing available capital. [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html) | [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260724~d484b483b9.en.pdf) | [CryptoSlate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQT2d1ZXRxQW1Qb2hGTkRjdjU4VHhPX3FaY0hpcEJ3M2M3UGYtVGstSEdFR1RoSF9zdXV1RnRyZ2c3Q1BwZWhLXy16V1BNajVQQjNkcXpmaTdreFBadE1RM05JSjExZ1QwUVlvS3BhMjNKdUcyYkdHMzNWam5lczgzRF9wNmM3ZURqT1ZZRENBd3hvMTJHb3lyYmhSaUdPVGExVDRQMV9zSTdRcER1T0h6RGQ3NA)
- **China’s economy faces weather shock and market pullback:** Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, forcing over 340,000 people to evacuate and causing mass flight cancellations. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell to 24,963, led by Alibaba and Tencent. Yet retail dynamism is returning with a World Cup windfall, and Chinese media push back on ‘weak domestic demand’ narratives, framing instead a ‘China Opportunity 2.0.’ [BBN Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOUl9Oa0xyVklfYk9kNTF5Y1B0Zzk5Qll4TXA5Vkg3SEhZZUxPekNRQndFWnhnQTVMVkRraVlNeVBHMHoteE9MX1kwZTBXRk9TeU9yRXVpaUdjTTJNRVFhLWhQT0xPeVZxMkxDYVFvVlNyWklESWJaRnQ5Q1ZIVzBmOXJTbFV3NXVtdVJ0WFlZUVlBUC1vWkJDTi1DMkZtZkJxSlpQT3dRTVdkVnhQV2wtbmR2a0FreEhJMFZMajQ5cmRUbFZTZG1TamdiSW8) | [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1tc0lfS1RjeEdaMU0tOF9rQlZBVEdtbUNXQm02RG9xSDR1OG1vM2lCQnNZVkJWZnZ4anB5Yy1zN2lKQlplMmdoZlRPYVV4am8tMkNzczBnNHh3MHE5Ulphclh3)
- **A tough week for US stocks boiled down to four forces:** Investors grappled with Middle East tensions, key tech earnings reports, healthcare developments, and trade policy. The S&P 500 nevertheless eked out a record close, though chip stocks weighed, and analysts at Yardeni note that mark-to-market and chip profit margins are distorting S&P 500 earnings. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/here-are-4-forces-that-drove-a-tough-week-for-stocks.html) | [Yardeni QuickTakes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQS2tseU03aWFxV3AyZEt1Y1lsam82Z3oxSUpxOWdudFBURVpueVpJNmx2cEM0dDBoSmJETk9vMFpUS3A4Mkx4b0RER2VacHJJU3F1TUtiWkhDYUJpSFN6WWN6UUVVdHo3MjVHYnZaZ25sNkxIVEFUbzBxM09pYUNGREd4aWVrTEttbFhSZlV6TE83RkM1eHhNd0xFcHFpUkxjQXVLS0V5Wi1Id2gwYkFCWWNORVpxZ09zS0xz)

**Watch next:** The legal battle over Trump’s tariffs will set the tone for trade-exposed equities. Any further escalation in Red Sea shipping attacks could push oil decisively above $100, impacting global inflation expectations. In AI, watch for regulatory signals on distillation as a bipartisan coalition of skeptics gains ground. For China, the aftermath of Typhoon Noul and the trajectory of Hong Kong’s retail recovery will be key near-term indicators.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻覆盖地缘冲突、自然灾害、社会变迁与学术荣誉。伊朗胡塞武装宣称导弹袭击沙特，美军拦截试图突破封锁的油轮，美伊局势持续紧张；法国西班牙森林大火迫使超30万人撤离，西班牙首相警告“复杂时刻”；意大利儿童肥胖率高居欧洲前列，传统地中海饮食难以抵挡快餐文化侵蚀。乌克兰无人机打击俄罗斯Wildberries仓库，影响中小企业与消费者；日本女性正通过非母职的生活方式重塑社会角色，北朝鲜替代经济中“无咖啡的咖啡”揭示了生存政治。中国方面，总书记对基础教育工作提出明确要求，第十六届中国航展定于12月开幕，外卖员王计兵诗集获中国最高文学奖，折射零工经济下蓝领文化觉醒。知乎社区因数学家邓煜获得菲尔兹奖而掀起重新认识这位年轻学者的热潮。

- [Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9d27v70j1o) — 胡塞武装声称袭击沙特，美军同日拦截一艘试图突破对伊朗封锁的油轮，显示波斯湾军事摩擦升级。
- [More than 300,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le0d53y2o) — 法国波尔多附近大火失控，近20万人撤离，西班牙北部同样遭受火情，高温干旱叠加的野火季创下纪录。
- [Pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein - how Italian children became so overweight](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c33y3151vydo) — WHO数据显示意大利儿童超重率欧洲领先，传统饮食被高热量加工食品取代，折射南欧健康危机。
- [Ukraine drone strikes on Wildberries warehouses hit Russian sellers, consumers](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/25/nx-s1-5905377) — 乌克兰远程无人机袭击俄罗斯电商巨头Wildberries仓库，重创本土小商家与消费者，引发对战争经济溢出效应的讨论。
- [Out of the shadows: Japanese women building a life beyond motherhood](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQWF9adHJNdmJXWldyVUZRNThoT1Q4eWIybmhiSExqMHBlQ2RTcUFmNzdBUmJuTWdpRlUxUnQ2aC0ycXhveExReVBCTDJaTkJrVkJIalhBc0dSTU16bnZPdUtXN084QlJSNHY0RU5YTjFWZGVUYmYtMTRNLVl0SldWRTNPSUg5UUx2) — 越来越多日本女性选择不生育，通过职场、兴趣与社交构建独立生活，挑战传统性别角色。
- [Coffee-less coffee and chocolates without cocoa ― survival and politics of North Korea subsitute economy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9MbWdDVzJ4SHltVFpLczZUZHJVMnhfc3dfTTZabDItUkg2bkJzNTEwYjFJZVFRUklwX3pUd09RM3hpZDVIV05mQ0hQR3ZMQXh0TElPSC1DNA) — 北朝鲜用替代品制作“咖啡”和“巧克力”，揭示制裁下民众的生存适应与政治控制手段。
- [微言微语 - 中国外卖员王计兵诗集获中国最高文学奖 从蓝领工人文学作品一窥中国庞大零工经济景况 - RFI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — 外卖员王计兵以诗集《赶时间的人》获得鲁迅文学奖，成为中国零工经济工人的文化发声标志。
- [菲尔兹奖之后，人们在知乎重新认识邓煜 - thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE51UUtFY0ktazVUUEkwb0VaOW9BczFvZUtodFluRlBoS1ZhNzhqaWc1Z3NuUGc4dkVTeUJBRXlYX3NIMm1kaUo0RFJ3d20zNWhiMnh1Y2pGUlNxUlNuam1udEpnNEg4NGNlM1k3UGhNUmhxQQ) — 知乎用户热议邓煜的成长经历与学术贡献，反映社区对纯粹知识探索的尊重。

**后续观察**：地缘冲突（中东、东欧）与气候灾害（南欧野火）构成当日两大风险主线，叠加效应可能影响能源价格与区域稳定。日本女性角色的结构性转变与北朝鲜替代经济的韧性，提示亚洲社会深层变迁。中国基层教育政策与零工经济文化现象的交织，值得长期关注。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating conflict in the Middle East, catastrophic wildfires in Western Europe, and shifting political currents in the U.S. and beyond. In social and cultural spheres, China’s education policy takes centre stage, while South Korea sees a tourism boom and Japan grapples with demographic and trade tensions. A surprise math celebrity emerges on Zhihu.

- **Iran-Houthi tensions escalate**: The Houthis claimed a missile attack on Saudi Arabia as the U.S. military disabled a tanker evading the Iranian blockade. The Iran war live blog reports Tehran summoned Ukraine diplomats over a Caspian Sea attack ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9d27v70j1o), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/26/iran-war-live-tehran-summons-ukraine-diplomats-over-caspian-sea-attack?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Massive wildfires in France and Spain**: Over 300,000 people have fled blazes near Bordeaux and in Spain, with Spain’s PM warning of “complex hours”. Evacuations around Bordeaux alone reached 200,000 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le0d53y2o), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/26/french-wildfires-trigger-mass-evacuations-around-bordeaux?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Tunisia marks five years of emergency rule**: Thousands rallied in Tunis calling for President Saied’s departure, the largest protest in years ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/26/tunisians-mark-fifth-year-of-emergency-rule-with-calls-for-saied-to-go?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Ukraine drone strikes hit Russian e-commerce**: Drone attacks on Wildberries warehouses hurt small sellers and consumers, illustrating the civilian impact of the war ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/25/nx-s1-5905377/ukraine-drone-strikes-on-wildberries-warehouses-hit-russian-sellers-consumers)).
- **China’s education focus**: President Xi outlined requirements for future basic education, and the 29th ‘My Motherland’ Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau student exchange camp opened. A notable cultural story: delivery driver Wang Jibing won a top literary prize for poetry ([央视](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE4xSlpsRHFvcFhmX3hVTmhodTl3QmNvT3hHTWtnQVRZUXV3OFBFTlhlcUE4M1FtU01Gam43RFJXVHB3VHRNc0FYUXBGYlBFREdOWVVUdk9zNk9MNXlSa1FaOUk1WXhUWk1GcGMxNVZYMzI5dw), [RFI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)).
- **South Korea tourism record**: Spending hit record highs as Japanese boycotts fade and visitor numbers grow ([Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOQ0d3amdreXBpQ1VBZ2xLM3BaS0wxT1Aybi11MnJfM0ZCWF94eVBsVnhIQmwxUk8tMlQ1N2VrZTcwWHo4NTFJaC1RTHpTd3JrbjZKWmozVjd6QUpmUkl2NVF4cVpld2h4T1cxR2g5MTV3eFplM3MxRlZ0QmY3cXVaM3BCbkRUUjFBdUVkclQyTFZnaUdiM1IxSWpxTHJjaVk)).
- **Zhihu celebrates Fields Medalist**: Following his Fields Medal win, people rediscover mathematician Deng Yu through an interview and his personal notes on poetry, football, and sci-fi ([thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE51UUtFY0ktazVUUEkwb0VaOW9BczFvZUtodFluRlBoS1ZhNzhqaWc1Z3NuUGc4dkVTeUJBRXlYX3NIMm1kaUo0RFJ3d20zNWhiMnh1Y2pGUlNxUlNuam1udEpnNEg4NGNlM1k3UGhNUmhxQQ), [finance.sina.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNSTdRVnh0dVRrRnpBQkxaUXZLSG5QQmhKYXpoLVJFZjNOV0lsaVR5OFF2a2lXMmpWNG03d0xIQ0s4MUsyWXBoNEkzdEh3amxvTXNjYUZ2THdLaEZNWENkWnZjRUgwOVBmZG9fN2pnSnh2dXFpb0JoeVZIdnBDR3lGSmY1OGRaNXAxSXI1NEZPOFk0Yy10TEk1cjVqN3EzRklncXJnZ0JXLUQtMzZraFQ4UlBBdVZwbEs3X1YzLUU3M0tHN2xvcHc)).

**Watch next**: Wildfire containment in France and Spain, diplomatic fallout from the Iran-Ukraine Caspian incident, and the Michigan primary test for left-wing Democrats will define the next news cycle. China’s education reforms and Japan’s trade rulings on steel will have longer-term economic ripple effects.

military.zh:
今日全球军事格局呈现出两条并行且相互关联的冲突线：一是乌克兰战争外溢至里海，乌军首次对伊朗向俄运送军事物资的船只实施打击，引发伊朗强烈威胁；二是美伊围绕核问题的军事对抗虽暂时降温，但红海与也门战火重燃。与此同时，美军在印太地区演练乌克兰式自杀无人艇，南海中菲摩擦持续，中国军方表态强硬。整体来看，局部冲突的技术手段（无人机、低造价巡航导弹）正加速扩散，大国代理人博弈的风险显著上升。

- **乌克兰远程打击穿透至里海**：乌军对里海俄方船只发动大规模无人机与导弹袭击，[击中俄军舰及运载伊朗货物的船只](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFBOdjRza3IzWmdTTFc3SWgwN3JQZUJtQy1VQV9SM0tsNGlYTHcyRVFYaEtmRHpVZWVhS0dYNzhhZGVGMWlzYy10eTIwX05ybkdrdkprYVY0YVpDYmk4XzVz)。伊朗声称一名海员死亡，[威胁用弹道导弹报复“全乌克兰”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNbWpsV1FHQnRnc2xZY0U0NWtFbTR4cVFOZDl2V2pXTU8weDZJaUlWdFNZc3Z1NWE1d2NkLTVfZmNCTWo4LUN0dy1wZElyT3Jaa3pVZ2JZVkszSFpkNjVWNmo0b0RnUld4TkpSSnVrVS10RTVrUUg1TnBadUVhcVFEQW5Mc21CMUNVd05vSjg2Q05FLVBUdjlKcHlmaE9oTC1TMW8tRWJSN25sWlpjc0d3)，这标志着乌克兰-伊朗间接冲突首次出现直接交火。
- **美伊正面军事冲突暂缓**：路透社与Ynetnews均报道，[特朗普在五角大楼预警拦截导弹短缺后，暂缓对伊朗大规模升级](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9ncTZXUkVoSjloQV9idHF3NDdhcGJZN2RpdVM5b1dKUmFXUDdGT0ZwOXdaYkNCLVZXOWdKUXM2Vmp3aWV1cE00SWVWYUl5eWdya2RYeGtsVQ)，[霍尔木兹海峡通行量暴跌至平时的不足一半](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)。但胡塞武装恢复对沙特石油设施攻击，希腊部署在沙特的防空系统拦截了来自也门的导弹。
- **美国海军在太平洋演练“乌克兰式”自杀无人艇**：在环太平洋2026演习的击沉科目中，[美军使用两艘单向攻击无人艇（USV）对退役两栖攻击舰佩莱利乌号（LHD 5）实施水线处爆破](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/u-s-navy-deploys-ukraine-style-kamikaze-sea-drones-during-pacific-sinkex/)，此举明显借鉴了乌军在黑海的成功战法，标志着美海军无人化反舰能力进入实战化测试。
- **南海紧张：日本首次派出陆上自卫队，中国出动航母**：朝鲜日报报道称，[面对日本陆上自卫队首次派遣至南海，中国出动航母应对](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3)；中国驻菲大使表态“坚决打回去”，双方底线性摩擦加剧。
- **美军采购低造价远程巡航导弹**：美国海军宣布通过“联盟异构可负担进攻性打击”（CHAOS）项目，[采购低成本巡航导弹以扩充舰队及盟友的远程打击能力](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)，反映未来海上消耗战的需求。

**后续观察**：乌克兰对伊朗船只的打击可能迫使伊朗更直接介入俄乌战场，甚至对乌境内目标实施弹道导弹袭击，从而扩大战争地理范围。美伊虽在正面战场降温，但代理人战争（红海、也门）继续升温。中国在南海的军事存在和强硬表态，结合美军在太平洋的无人化测试，暗示印太海上军备竞赛正从传统平台转向无人化、低成本消耗体系。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have seen a dramatic expansion of the conflict zone as Ukraine confirmed long-range strikes on Russian warships and vessels carrying Iranian military cargo in the Caspian Sea, drawing direct threats from Tehran. Meanwhile, the US-Iran front remained relatively quiet amid a Pentagon-reported interceptor shortage, while Houthi attacks in the Red Sea intensified. In the Indo-Pacific, China deployed a carrier in response to Japanese troop movements, and the US Navy tested Ukraine-style kamikaze sea drones during a Pacific SINKEX.

- **Ukraine strikes Iranian-linked shipping in Caspian Sea**: Kyiv hit multiple vessels transporting Iranian military cargo, killing at least one sailor. Iran's foreign ministry threatened 'ballistic missiles' against Ukraine, stating 'All of Ukraine is within reach' ([Ynetnews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9ncTZXUkVoSjloQV9idHF3NDdhcGJZN2RpdVM5b1dKUmFXUDdGT0ZwOXdaYkNCLVZXOWdKUXM2Vmp3aWV1cE00SWVWYUl5eWdya2RYeGtsVQ)).

- **US holds back on major Iran escalation**: The Pentagon warned of a shortage of air defense interceptors, leading President Trump to forgo major strikes against Iran. The Strait of Hormuz transits dropped sharply ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxPYnVSWlhuMFM5LW94bUxZY2tSeDlTX3p1RC1yNk10aVJobG02aVpFeGc3bFowLVZIT01sQk5yekpRWHNUYmhiS3gxSmJTbF9YU2hROXlmQ3hSMVFvaVpDZlhuUXp6N0d4c2lERjlra2NFeXp6Y1Uwd3M2U3prWUp2LTNvMG5Zd05laVktTmJXaXFTNnp4V3U2RkUwV0FNM04yc0dsQWZKc1BtOFk2aDFKQlUwc21pdW9k)).

- **Houthis resume Red Sea attacks, target Saudi-linked ships**: Yemeni government forces struck Houthi launch sites, but the militia enacted a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabian-linked ports, further disrupting shipping ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)).

- **China deploys carrier as Japan sends troops to South China Sea**: In response to Japan's first-ever deployment of Ground Self-Defense Force personnel to the region, China moved a carrier to assert its position, escalating a tense standoff ([朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3)).

- **US Navy tests drone swarm tactics in Pacific SINKEX**: Two one-way attack surface drones, inspired by Ukrainian tactics, helped sink the ex-USS Peleliu off Hawaii during RIMPAC 2026 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/u-s-navy-deploys-ukraine-style-kamikaze-sea-drones-during-pacific-sinkex/)).

- **US Navy orders low-cost cruise missiles for allied strike**: The CHAOS program selects CoAspire to produce affordable long-range maritime strike munitions, expanding allied capabilities ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)).

- **White House protests congressional block on foreign warship purchases**: The OMB opposes an NDAA provision banning procurement of battle force ships from foreign yards, citing industrial base constraints ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)).

**Watch next**: Iran's threatened retaliation against Ukraine could open a new front, while the Houthi blockade may force a stronger US or Saudi response. In the Pacific, the RIMPAC exercise and ongoing Chinese carrier movements will test alliance cohesion.

tech.zh:
今天科技新闻呈现出几个显著脉络：汽车领域，比亚迪在全球攻城略地，但本土市场收缩正在侵蚀利润，揭示了全球化车企的典型阵痛；AI领域，硅谷内部的反AI情绪开始显性化，从图书馆的“逃避AI”工作坊到工人抗议，再到欧盟对TikTok未成年安全的施压，技术乐观主义的光芒下暗流涌动；科技产品方面，巨头间的法律攻防与硬件涨价预期并存，Warner Bros.起诉Amazon挖角，Qualcomm计划提价，同时SpaceX的Starship稳步推进；HackNews社区则关注DeepSeek暂停融资的内幕、JetZero的创新航空设计等深度话题。

- [BYD's Global Sales Surge Masks a Home-Market Contraction That's Hitting Margins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOOWN1eEpzVGIzMnRkRnAzVjZEdnZiV2dxc29lbW15Ykt1VllrQ2RKQVFmSWtiT3l6VjVjMW94dGhGVHBNMVd3WXdEdm43WF84NDBFYVVGUzJDbkJ1OVlUNVM3WXQxcE9FbXJYcG9OZVdncS1TZl9ieUtrTDNYYUxYXzR3ZWx0NzVoRm5jc2tJNDRWMWp5MzdkUUN0NHNlX2tRN2JHT0tjRzJUc0hWZTFvdl8wcnhkVHFLZGNNSmJaR0FfMVJsakZJQVlB) ——比亚迪全球销量掩盖了本土市场收缩，这对所有高举全球化扩张的中国车企都是警示信号。
- [Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/waymo-is-2-3-safer-than-a-human-driver-says-iihs-with-some-caveats/) ——IIHS研究显示Waymo事故率比人类低68%，但数据存在局限性，自动驾驶安全辩论再添新素材。
- [Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/librarians-are-hosting-viral-avoiding-ai-workshops-for-people-who-are-fed-up-with-big-tech/) ——图书馆举办的“逃避AI”工作坊意外火爆，反映出公众对科技巨头及其AI入侵的厌倦正在形成社会运动。
- [They built AI. Now Silicon Valley workers protest its threat to jobs and humanity](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) ——硅谷内部出现罕见的分裂：AI的创造者开始上街抗议自己造出的东西。
- [Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/warner-bros-lawsuit-accuses-amazon-of-illegally-poaching-executives/) ——华纳兄弟起诉亚马逊挖角高管，这场诉讼可能重新界定加州竞业限制协议的效力。
- [Qualcomm is reportedly planning to raise processor prices by the end of the summer](https://www.engadget.com/2223161/qualcomm-planning-to-raise-its-prices/) ——高通计划今夏提价，结合谷歌确认Pixel 11将涨价，手机SoC涨价潮正在酝酿。
- [DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript)](https://github.com/demo-zexuan/liang-wenfeng-investor-meeting-2026-7-22/blob/master/%E6%A2%81%E6%96%87%E9%94%8B%E6%8A%95%E8%B5%84%E8%80%85%E4%BA%A4%E6%B5%81%E4%BC%9A-%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E7%A8%BF_1_18_translate_20260723201651.pdf) ——DeepSeek因内部会议录音泄露中对中国算力差距的评论而暂停融资，暴露中美AI竞赛的敏感性和信息管控风险。

**后续观察：** 今天的信息流呈现出一个有趣的分裂：官方叙事（AI让生活更美好、中国车企出海高歌猛进）与民间情绪（逃避AI、抗议AI、本土市场萎缩）形成张力。投资者和监管者需要高度关注这些“影子信号”——它们可能比财报更早预示转折。
tech.en:
Today's technology landscape is marked by stark contradictions: AI's relentless expansion faces a growing backlash from workers and the public, while the electric vehicle sector navigates global success against domestic headwinds. Autonomous driving gets a safety validation with caveats, and hardware costs are climbing across the board. The Hacker News community dives into hands-on projects and critical industry leaks.

- **BYD's global sales surge masks a home-market contraction** that is squeezing margins, as the Chinese giant surpasses Ford but struggles domestically. ([AD HOC NEWS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOOWN1eEpzVGIzMnRkRnAzVjZEdnZiV2dxc29lbW15Ykt1VllrQ2RKQVFmSWtiT3l6VjVjMW94dGhGVHBNMVd3WXdEdm43WF84NDBFYVVGUzJDbkJ1OVlUNVM3WXQxcE9FbXJYcG9OZVdncS1TZl9ieUtrTDNYYUxYXzR3ZWx0NzVoRm5jc2tJNDRWMWp5MzdkUUN0NHNlX2tRN2JHT0tjRzJUc0hWZTFvdl8wcnhkVHFLZGNNSmJaR0FfMVJsakZJQVlB))
- **Waymo's autonomous taxis crash 68% less than human drivers**, according to IIHS, but the data comes with important caveats about operational domain and severity. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/waymo-is-2-3-safer-than-a-human-driver-says-iihs-with-some-caveats/))
- **Tesla faces federal scrutiny** after claiming its Full Self-Driving can handle whiteout conditions; regulators demand receipts. ([Yahoo Autos](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPVVhwV2xNc2M5WGpiRlJSNVNvWUdnWE9OQ3F2TEpyTUhNcC1mUWlNcVlwZHZuTG5oZWdxdFhFN0o1OE84dWlXUWRKQnJoQVZhamdVU09KaDNSMm56Y3o2MXEtZ0hDTjQ0Z3dGbF9jRktXZ20zM2QzLW5zWXI2OUhjMXZlX21mQWlRNk9HcGhyLTd4bU9qUWNVZVhqcGdfZjVMN3VlMw))
- **The 'Avoiding AI' movement gains momentum**: librarians host viral workshops as public fatigue with Big Tech's AI push boils over. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/librarians-are-hosting-viral-avoiding-ai-workshops-for-people-who-are-fed-up-with-big-tech/))
- **AI-fueled layoffs continue**: Monday.com joins a growing list of tech companies citing AI as a reason for job cuts, while Silicon Valley workers protest the technology's threat to jobs and humanity. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/the-running-list-major-tech-layoffs-in-2026-where-employers-cited-ai/), [Imperial Valley Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_))
- **Hardware costs are rising**: Qualcomm plans processor price hikes, and Google confirms the Pixel 11 will cost more than its predecessor, partly due to RAM supply issues linked to AI data centers. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2223161/qualcomm-planning-to-raise-its-prices/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971041/google-confirms-pixel-11-price-hike))
- **DeepSeek pauses fundraising** after a leaked transcript reveals candid comments about the compute gap between China and the US, sparking debate on HN. ([GitHub PDF](https://github.com/demo-zexuan/liang-wenfeng-investor-meeting-2026-7-22/blob/master/%E6%A2%81%E6%96%87%E9%94%8B%E6%8A%95%E8%B5%84%E8%80%85%E4%BA%A4%E6%B5%81%E4%BC%9A-%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E7%A8%BF_1_18_translate_20260723201651.pdf))
- **Community projects shine**: JetZero's blended-wing aircraft, an ESP32-based plane radar, and a map of every US golf course capture the maker spirit on Hacker News. ([JetZero](https://www.jetzero.aero/), [blog.ktz.me](https://blog.ktz.me/esp32-plane-radar/), [golfcoursebrowser.com](https://golfcoursebrowser.com/))

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on SpaceX's next Starship tower catch attempt, the EU's escalating action against TikTok over minors' safety, and the fallout from DeepSeek's fundraising pause as it signals growing tensions in the global AI race.

sports.zh:
今日全球体坛迎来多个高潮：拳坛重量级对决正式敲定，F1匈牙利站诺里斯夺杆，环法波加查逼近第五冠，中国羽毛球公开赛国羽提前锁定混双金牌，NBA詹姆斯转会费城引发连锁反应。

- [Anthony Joshua两次被击倒后第二回合KO普伦加，预定与泰森·富里超级大战](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/cgew1lrpgzro) — 约书亚在沙特阿拉伯经历惊险逆转，赛后泪洒赛场，这场英伦对决将成为年底最受瞩目的拳击盛宴。
- [兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利大奖赛夺得赛季首个杆位，汉密尔顿因罚退后表示“积极心态受考验”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/cm2gd6gd33go) — 迈凯伦有望打破本赛季冠军荒，红牛与法拉利的竞争格局出现松动。
- [塔代伊·波加查即将创纪录地第五次夺得环法自行车赛冠军，卡拉帕兹拿下第20赛段](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c1d141dl2qro) — 斯洛文尼亚车手正逼近安杜兰等传奇，新时代已然到来。
- [中国羽毛球公开赛半决赛：国羽3胜1负，提前包揽混双冠亚军，陈雨菲晋级女单决赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOU1JHOEpxQmRCT3RiZW9fSVgyX2pwVVkzSVhxNFVndVBGM1k0ZHM1dU1JVkNRanlwX3pwQkV5akFPdU9SSTZFSDVQTWxxdmNfa24xN0JFOXNOSXJ0V0JTSVNTVVlNd2lDeWVIZXBDUTd4TWQ5d3J2UjZjcXp6Y01IZEJpdjcyV2VHWHRYWUJIU3NRMTA) — 女单世界第2爆冷出局，但整体表现强势，明天女单、女双、混双均有冲金点。
- [勒布朗·詹姆斯宣布加盟费城76人，湖人新援格兰姆斯晒训练照与老詹轨迹相反](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9lN0NpZHpjdnNBaHRqVzRXRmpDcHllWFNwMGVaeHBHZnJJYTJmNUtnRE9CM2lUU2JnMXRHMzRMSTVXcEVKNUtfaklIWlg5aXFVdzRKejNLWUUxSXo4aEdSd0o0RQ) — NBA权力格局瞬间改变，湖人将被迫重建。
- [足球转会：阿森纳探索签下维尼修斯，皇马报价迪奥曼德被拒，凯尔特人即将签下博多格林特前锋霍格](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yw2wqxvjwo) — 欧洲夏季窗口持续升温，多笔交易接近达成。

**后续观察：** 明日重点关注约书亚-富里合约正式签署、匈牙利F1正赛结果、环法巴黎收官站、中国公开赛决赛日，以及NBA自由市场后续交易。詹姆斯加盟76人后，湖人可能的应对措施值得持续跟踪。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours delivered a mix of high drama and strategic moves across major sports. Anthony Joshua survived two knockdowns to stop Kristian Prenga, setting up a megafight with Tyson Fury. Luke Littler continued his darting rampage at the World Matchplay, while Lando Norris seized pole in Hungary. In cycling, Tadej Pogacar stands on the brink of a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title. Badminton’s China Open saw Chinese stars dominate, and basketball fans followed the curious roster swap involving Quentin Grimes and LeBron James.

- **Joshua vs. Fury is set**: Anthony Joshua recovered from being knocked down twice inside 20 seconds to knock out Kristian Prenga in Jeddah, dedicating the win to late friends. The victory rubberstamps a blockbuster showdown with Tyson Fury later this year. [Joshua-Fury moves closer as AJ KOs Prenga](https://www.skysports.com/boxing/news/12040/13566890/anthony-joshua-knocks-out-kristian-prenga-after-huge-scare-to-move-closer-to-blockbuster-showdown-with-tyson-fury) [Joshua devotes win to late friends](https://www.skysports.com/boxing/news/12040/13567030/anthony-joshua-remembers-late-friends-after-win-over-kristian-prenga-sets-up-tyson-fury-fight-and-lovely-treat-for-fans)
- **Littler on course for history**: 19-year-old Luke Littler reached the World Matchplay final and is on track to break Phil Taylor’s tournament average record. He will face Gerwyn Price. [Littler sets up Price final at World Matchplay](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/darts/articles/cx2dgz20n2ro)
- **Norris leads in Hungary**: Lando Norris took pole for the Hungarian Grand Prix, calling McLaren’s pace “new man’s land,” while Lewis Hamilton faces a penalty and vows to fight back. [Norris cautious despite pole](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/cm2gd6gd33go)
- **Pogacar on verge of fifth Tour title**: Tadej Pogacar is poised to equal the record for most Tour de France wins after Richard Carapaz won a dramatic stage 20 to Alpe d’Huez. [Paris awaits as Pogacar poised](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c1d141dl2qro)
- **China Open badminton: Chen Yufei and mixed doubles in focus**: Chinese shuttlers secured gold and silver in multiple categories, with Chen Yufei advancing to the women’s singles final. France’s Toma Junior Popov reached his first final. [2026年中国羽毛球公开赛半决赛综述](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOU1JHOEpxQmRCT3RiZW9fSVgyX2pwVVkzSVhxNFVndVBGM1k0ZHM1dU1JVkNRanlwX3pwQkV5akFPdU9SSTZFSDVQTWxxdmNfa24xN0JFOXNOSXJ0V0JTSVNTVVlNd2lDeWVIZXBDUTd4TWQ5d3J2UjZjcXp6Y01IZEJpdjcyV2VHWHRYWUJIU3NRMTA) [中国羽球公开赛：法选手大波波夫](https://news.google.)
- **Quentin Grimes trains with Lakers as James heads to Philly**: Lakers guard Quentin Grimes posted training photos in Lakers gear, with fans noting the irony that LeBron James is moving to the 76ers—the team Grimes just left. [轨迹相反！格兰姆斯ins晒出训练照](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9lN0NpZHpjdnNBaHRqVzRXRmpDcHllWFNwMGVaeHBHZnJJYTJmNUtnRE9CM2lUU2JnMXRHMzRMSTVXcEVKNUtfaklIWlg5aXFVdzRKejNLWUUxSXo4aEdSd0o0RQ)

**Watch next**: The Joshua-Fury fight will dominate heavyweight headlines, but Sunday’s Hungarian Grand Prix and the Luke Littler vs. Gerwyn Price final could produce more drama. In China, the badminton finals will test whether Chen Yufei can reclaim the title. Keep an eye on Chelsea’s late-window moves after completing a deal for Crystal Palace’s Maxence Lacroix.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条被圣迭戈动漫展（SDCC）全面接管，漫威在Hall H连放三颗重磅炸弹：Ryan Gosling版恶灵骑士、David Jonsson版黑豹之子和《复仇者联盟：末日》预告，直接引爆全球粉丝圈。欧美区外，Katy Perry罕见怒怼白宫滥用其歌曲、Tom Holland自嘲烂片经历也引发热议。日韩方面，TXT在KM Chart Awards斩获五项大奖成为年度艺人，《特工金》以23%收视率收官。国内微博则被卢昱晓道歉、李权哲高铁占座、刘亦菲国籍旧照等争议刷屏，娱乐圈的“人设”与“边界”议题再次浮出水面。
- [Katy Perry ‘Deeply Appalled’ After White House Uses ‘Firework’ in Military Strikes TikTok Video](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/katy-perry-white-house-firework-military-strikes-tiktok-1235598831/) — 她公开表示音乐是团结而非战争工具，白宫此举引发政治与娱乐交叉争议。
- [Marvel’s Comic-Con Panel Excites Fans for ‘Doomsday’ but Leaves Them Cautiously Optimistic About What’s Beyond](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/marvel-comic-con-doomsday-ghost-rider-black-panther-1236821335/) — 除了《末日》预告，Ryan Gosling的恶灵骑士和David Jonsson的黑豹3定档2028，漫威未来牌面清晰但粉丝仍嫌不足。
- [Tom Holland Admits Some Of His Movies Were Hard To Promote “Because It’s Sh*t”](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-admits-some-movies-hard-promote-1237003784/) — 荷兰弟坦率发言令舆论哗然，却也为其敬业形象加分。
- [Winners Of The KM Chart Awards (KMA) 2026](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857355wpp/winners-of-the-km-chart-awards-kma-2026) — TXT凭五座奖杯登顶，KMA巩固了K-pop新生代格局。
- [分享日常意外踩业内禁忌！卢昱晓一错再错发文道歉爆了热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQd1pqYlBwRUNDY2R3eGVRZ25UMy1fRjd6QTVhOHk4SzR5Yll5TDF2czVIVEpwTWc4RXh6eWluWTBRa29VeGE0b1FlMmppNXREVzF3RnA5NTh3bkRuSVUwOUtMUXR2a1RKYjRQcG03VHVYOWJONm5SY21uRzdYUkI1NmcxTQ) — 因分享日常踩中行业禁忌，连续道歉反而引爆热搜，暴露新生代艺人“边界感”缺失。
- [刘亦菲美国初中班级合照曝光！她是美国人，来中国赚钱很受欢迎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQbW52dTNQMjI3QnhISEhCbWRHVWpXLXlhQlBOdUlJZldhdmdmcVhxaEMyVzVLMDNJMEJ1azdWRC0zek9XbnF6RS1wZDY0ZkZlWlpWczBhNVhxTmlhbDdUYWlmb0o2d3ZzLTJ2dnc4UVMyM2hGSmk2cUVZSDB3MnhZZElGSHhJd201bXdfNVR6ekpEZjI1dHFOdlh5U0ZkcU9OcEtGUDhkd094djg) — 旧照疑再次引发对其国籍与市场定位的讨论。

**后续观察：** Comic-Con后续效应将持续发酵，特别是《黑豹3》选角争议与《报仇者联盟》剧情走向；日韩剧集收视大洗牌，值得追踪新剧《Love on the Menu》能否接棒；国内艺人的社交分享“雷区”正成为新的公关考验。
entertainment.en:
The last 24 hours were dominated by Marvel's massive Comic-Con panel, which unveiled major casting and release dates, while a political controversy erupted around Katy Perry. In China, celebrity scandals and social media storms captured public attention, and Korea celebrated its KM Chart Awards. Below are the key developments shaping today's entertainment landscape.

- **Marvel Studios' Comic-Con panel** was the headline event, with announcements including Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/ryan-gosling-ghost-rider-marvel-comic-con-1237003726/)), David Jonsson as T'Challa's son in *Black Panther 3* ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/black-panther-3-december-2028-release-david-jonsson-1236083370/)), and the *Avengers: Doomsday* trailer raising an army of Sentinels ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/avengers-doomsday-new-trailer-comic-con-1236817677/)).
- **Katy Perry publicly condemned** the White House for using her song 'Firework' in a military strikes TikTok video, calling it 'deeply appalled' ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/katy-perry-white-house-firework-military-strikes-tiktok-1235598831/)). The incident underscores the tension between artists and political institutions.
- **Tom Holland admitted** some of his past films were 'sh*t' and hard to promote, contrasting with his current blockbusters ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-admits-some-movies-hard-promote-1237003784/)). This candid remark may fuel discussions about actor authenticity.
- **Warner Bros. filed a lawsuit** against Amazon, accusing the company of poaching employees and unfair competition ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/warner-bros-amazon-lawsuit-pirate-away-employees-pia-barlow-1236656642/)). This legal battle could reshape talent retention strategies in Hollywood.
- **In Korea, TXT dominated** the KM Chart Awards, winning five awards including Artist of the Year ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857355wpp/winners-of-the-km-chart-awards-kma-2026)). Meanwhile, *Agent Kim Reactivated* ended with a 23% rating, the highest of 2026 ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857346wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ends-on-no-1-ratings-as-love-on-the-menu-premieres-to-promising-start)).
- **Chinese social media buzzed** with controversies: singer Li Quanzhe accused of seat hogging on high-speed rail ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE55eTk4bUtfSzlPVEpkTzB5Mk9leEVEbWhaUlBnQ3JrQTR3eWxVZ0wyZEJ5RmNkVnlfV2VyU1RmN0MtSklKemtLQlZ3WmZwblUyNWlpX2JDQTRvb19oUFluOU1pRXVCOTRWUHp6eWhqWkVBQUc1Zlo3N2tQSWdFUQ)), and actor Lu Yuxiao apologizing for a social media post ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQd1pqYlBwRUNDY2R3eGVRZ25UMy1fRjd6QTVhOHk4SzR5Yll5TDF2czVIVEpwTWc4RXh6eWluWTBRa29VeGE0b1FlMmppNXREVzF3RnA5NTh3bkRuSVUwOUtMUXR2a1RKYjRQcG03VHVYOWJONm5SY21uRzdYUkI1NmcxTQ)).
- **Liu Yifei's US middle school photo** went viral, reigniting debate over her nationality and career in China ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQbW52dTNQMjI3QnhISEhCbWRHVWpXLXlhQlBOdUlJZldhdmdmcVhxaEMyVzVLMDNJMEJ1azdWRC0zek9XbnF6RS1wZDY0ZkZlWlpWczBhNVhxTmlhbDdUYWlmb0o2d3ZzLTJ2dnc4UVMyM2hGSmk2cUVZSDB3MnhZZElGSHhJd201bXdfNVR6ekpEZjI1dHFOdlh5U0ZkcU9OcEtGUDhkd094djg)).
- **Wang Junkai's studio** engaged in 'reverse push' by asking fans to stop demanding updates, sparking a trending topic ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11ZXp6eVhwZjFEX09FWEl1YkNRX2xSeWlYd1FwdmdkaVhZM3pBeFVMbHJwZWs3d0hEVzkwUERLczhJME5PVnhaQmZMVlE2ZnFrS0YzSnk5blhmVkdfYUlQd1FwVFNNZmZFYWZqOFZuMlo)).

**Watch next:** As Comic-Con wraps, expect detailed reactions from fans and critics to Marvel's slate, particularly the *Avengers: Doomsday* trailer. The Katy Perry-White House clash may escalate if more artists speak out. In China, the Li Quanzhe incident could lead to official statements, while Lu Yuxiao's apology may test fan loyalty. Korean drama ratings for new premieres like *Love on the Menu* will be closely watched.

美股.zh:
美股上周经历震荡，标普500勉强收于7412点的纪录新高，但芯片股走弱掩盖了市场分歧。地缘政治与政策风险交织，投资者在科技巨头财报与中东冲突间疲于应对。

- **标普500创新高但结构分化**：尽管指数创纪录，Yardeni分析师指出市值加权与等权重盈利正被MTM（盯市）和芯片利润扭曲，但“害怕踏空”情绪仍然主导。[[S&P 500 Record Close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOQmJYMFpSbzliSmV5X3BZSDRXcUNOWU1YUUZfUExBTUVYR2FfV3hoYWpiQ1RPeFZmbFRoZTlTUGRGMHNNOXl0QUZrVWNiWi1vbHN6TWpqNE9YaE5RVHNMZDdUZVpnbUdicjdqTElvOXpKa2R1UFMtd0IxMDJ4VnMxaFlBcXEyd201UDJOSTRtaVdqSmlVeEhvTkx5VnE4UEF0V0NfX1h2dExFU2pqdmRxOWRkOGRpTDVlRUxkanN3)] [[US Market Call](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQS2tseU03aWFxV3AyZEt1Y1lsam82Z3oxSUpxOWdudFBURVpueVpJNmx2cEM0dDBoSmJETk9vMFpUS3A4Mkx4b0RER2VacHJJU3F1TUtiWkhDYUJpSFN6WWN6UUVVdHo3MjVHYnZaZ25sNkxIVEFUbzBxM09pYUNGREd4aWVrTEttbFhSZlV6TE83RkM1eHhNd0xFcHFpUkxjQXVLS0V5Wi1Id2gwYkFCWWNORVpxZ09zS0xz)]
- **中东冲突冲击能源与航运**：沙特拦截导弹、胡塞袭击Red Sea油轮，油价逼近100美元。物流巨头UPS、FedEx、DHL加速布局冷链医疗运输，GLP-1药物需求凸显冷库设施瓶颈。[[Oil prices near $100](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jul/23/andy-burnham-business-rates-pubs-clubs-live-music-vape-shops-european-central-bank-ecb-interest-rates-latest-news-updates)] [[Logistics giants healthcare](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/ups-fedex-dhl-healthare-logistics-glp.html)]
- **AI硬件军备竞赛**：英伟达锁定SK海力士HBM内存，用于其GPU和系统，这笔高达5000亿美元的交易巩固了芯片供应链。同时“蒸馏”技术引发硅谷与华盛顿的监管辩论。[[Nvidia locks down memory](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/nvidia-locks-down-memory-from-sk-hynix-as-part-of-500-billion-ai-deal.html)]
- **关税诉讼与遗产税争议**：特朗普新关税生效即被诉，巴菲特表态支持遗产税但自己通过捐赠规避。[[Trump tariffs lawsuit](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html)] [[Buffett estate tax](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/buffett-favors-an-estate-tax-but-like-virtually-all-billionaires-he-wont-be-paying-it.html)]

**收束**：美股在高位面临多重逆风：油价、关税、AI监管不确定性。下周科技巨头财报与中东局势演变将是影响短中期方向的关键变量。
美股.en:
US equities ended a volatile week with the S&P 500 closing at a record 7,411.98, though chip stocks remained a drag. Geopolitical risk, tariff news, and AI supply-chain moves dominated. 
- Saudi military strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen and attacks on Red Sea shipping pushed oil near $100, raising inflation concerns for the first time in months. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/saudi-military-strikes-iran-backed-houthi-targets-yemen.html)
- Trump’s new tariffs (25% on Brazil, 50% threatened on Canada) were immediately challenged in court; experts doubt they will hold up under IEEPA. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html)
- Nvidia secured high-bandwidth memory supply from SK Hynix as part of a $500B AI deal, cementing its dominance in AI hardware. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/nvidia-locks-down-memory-from-sk-hynix-as-part-of-500-billion-ai-deal.html)
- AI distillation emerged as a hot regulatory topic, with a new coalition of skeptics—including evangelicals and labor unions—pushing back. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/25/trump-ai-data-center-backlash.html)
- Yardeni QuickTakes warns that mark-to-market and chip profit margins are distorting S&P 500 earnings, though the ‘FEMO’ (Fear of Missing Out) trade persists. [Yardeni QuickTakes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQS2tseU03aWFxV3AyZEt1Y1lsam82Z3oxSUpxOWdudFBURVpueVpJNmx2cEM0dDBoSmJETk9vMFpUS3A4Mkx4b0RER2VacHJJU3F1TUtiWkhDYUJpSFN6WWN6UUVVdHo3MjVHYnZaZ25sNkxIVEFUbzBxM09pYUNGREd4aWVrTEttbFhSZlV6TE83RkM1eHhNd0xFcHFpUkxjQXVLS0V5Wi1Id2gwYkFCWWNORVpxZ09zS0xz)

**Signal:** The convergence of Middle East conflict and trade litigation could cap upside for equities despite a record close; watch for a rotation into energy and defense.

中国经济.zh:
港股受科技股拖累下跌，台风“红霞”冲击华南交通与物流。但香港零售因世界杯效应回暖，交易所研究延长交易时间吸引内地资金。内需疲软论遭官媒反击，局部亮点仍在。

- **恒指跌2%至24963点**：阿里巴巴、腾讯领跌，科技板块集体回调。[[Hang Seng Index Falls](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOUl9Oa0xyVklfYk9kNTF5Y1B0Zzk5Qll4TXA5Vkg3SEhZZUxPekNRQndFWnhnQTVMVkRraVlNeVBHMHoteE9MX1kwZTBXRk9TeU9yRXVpaUdjTTJNRVFhLWhQT0xPeVZxMkxDYVFvVlNyWklESWJaRnQ5Q1ZIVzBmOXJTbFV3NXVtdVJ0WFlZUVlBUC1vWkJDTi1DMkZtZkJxSlpQT3dRTVdkVnhQV2wtbmR2a0FreEhJMFZMajQ5cmRUbFZTZG1TamdiSW8)]
- **台风“红霞”登陆广东**：34万人撤离，深圳、广州等多机场航班大面积取消或延误，短期影响经济活动和供应链。[[Typhoon Noul landfall](https://news.google.)]
- **香港零售因世界杯获提振**：社评称世界杯为香港带来“意外之财”，零售业重现活力。同时港交所考虑延长交易时间以吸引内地基金，引发业界分歧。[[Dynamism returns to HK retail](https://news.google.)] [[HK exchange mulls longer hours](https://news.google.)]
- **内需疲软论遭驳斥**：同花顺社区文章称“中国冲击2.0混淆视听，中国机遇2.0是共识”，庞东来超市创始人受邀参加总理经济座谈会，显示对消费活力的认可。[[China impact 2.0](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5tbWt1TVpLSkVHTlp1cFpLWGhTdUNELWlzaEJiVG44M3kwUjV1MFpjRS1vSWlQanVPcE9TVUtsOTZXNmt2Z0swX0U2bUwtTzV0c2hPNURaQzEtNHV2emVjSw)] [[Meet Yu Donglai](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361755/meet-yu-donglai-founder-chinas-viral-supermarket-chain-and-guest-premier-li-qiang)]

**收束**：短期台风扰动与港股科技回调叠加，但消费端仍有结构性机会（如新零售标杆）。关注后续港交所交易时间改革动向及内地稳增长政策信号。
中国经济.en:
China’s economy faced a dual shock from Typhoon Noul and a sharp Hong Kong market selloff, but underlying retail and policy signals point to resilience. 
- Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China, forcing over 340,000 evacuations and causing mass flight cancellations at multiple Guangdong airports. [Business Standard](https://news.google.)
- Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell to 24,963, led by Alibaba and Tencent, while the exchange mulls longer trading hours to attract China funds. [BBN Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOUl9Oa0xyVklfYk9kNTF5Y1B0Zzk5Qll4TXA5Vkg3SEhZZUxPekNRQndFWnhnQTVMVkRraVlNeVBHMHoteE9MX1kwZTBXRk9TeU9yRXVpaUdjTTJNRVFhLWhQT0xPeVZxMkxDYVFvVlNyWklESWJaRnQ5Q1ZIVzBmOXJTbFV3NXVtdVJ0WFlZUVlBUC1vWkJDTi1DMkZtZkJxSlpQT3dRTVdkVnhQV2wtbmR2a0FreEhJMFZMajQ5cmRUbFZTZG1TamdiSW8)
- SCMP reports that Xinjiang could serve as a bridge for Hong Kong to Central Asia, balancing risks and opportunities. [SCMP](https://news.google.)
- Retail dynamism returns to Hong Kong with a World Cup windfall, while ‘credit rental’ schemes launch in Shanghai. [SCMP](https://news.google.) | [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9UblRZSGVYdjFVdzBLem1ZRXljWEhycl9GZHR3NWdSNVpYTVlIRFNpSlZRa1NSYjM5ZTE2dmh2d013SldWbVV4TzVUYXJpNDZTMEtvRDl1WmZXb01WMHY4YzZR)
- Chinese state-media aligned commentary dismisses ‘China Shock 2.0’ as misleading, arguing ‘China Opportunity 2.0’ is the real story. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5tbWt1TVpLSkVHTlp1cFpLWGhTdUNELWlzaEJiVG44M3kwUjV1MFpjRS1vSWlQanVPcE9TVUtsOTZXNmt2Z0swX0U2bUwtTzV0c2hPNURaQzEtNHV2emVjSw)

**Signal:** Weather-related disruptions and tech-led index weakness may be temporary; watch for fiscal stimulus or property market measures in the coming weeks.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲股市周一反弹，CAC40收于8372点，但地缘风险与能源价格飙升令前景承压。ECB继续推进绿色抵押框架，希腊成为中国电商平台最佳欧盟市场。

- **欧股反弹但油价阴影笼罩**：巴黎CAC40指数上涨至8372.28点，收复早盘失地。然而美国打击伊朗、胡塞攻击红海油轮使油价逼近100美元，欧洲能源进口成本上升。[[CAC 40 Rally](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNbEZkNko3aWIzRmw4aExZbE5NVVVZSTQyNlkwYWRwZGZURDNZSUhIeGZkdGRSOE9QazM5U3owaFdFY20xa1VLWkJPMkNicFhqeC13RURHekZtZ1BEOEVxRmFnaTFuY1BjcVRhY2dLcUdtYmtNTUpuWHBNR1l1cExVQUk2VE5kQ1Q1ZWZHRHY2R1JGeWROVGxHa1JjREk2MklQZWdVS2dhaElNMUNoLUJuYlVZZmg4dw)] [[Oil prices near $100](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jul/23/andy-burnham-business-rates-pubs-clubs-live-music-vape-shops-european-central-bank-ecb-interest-rates-latest-news-updates)]
- **ECB强化绿色抵押**：欧洲央行决定将气候因素扩展至非金融企业信贷债权抵押框架，并发布证券融资和OTC衍生品市场信贷条件调查结果。[[ECB climate factors](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)] [[SESFOD results](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_3~c0b45e246f.en.html)]
- **希腊成中国平台最佳欧盟市场**：eKathimerini报道称，希腊是中国电商和支付平台在欧盟渗透率最高的国家，反映出中欧数字贸易的微观格局。[[Greece is Chinese platforms’ best market](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQR1hJdktnejM2LTBPRjZ3SEQtSVNkajlHUG1XTUF6VVJUckZyUTVIRWpGMHl4MjN1QURWS1AydUdhbXMwYVlFUU9lSXNwS2JZMlhfeDBvQXNjZEdiOVZxMWpiU0R3WUhFS0Q2WllWSXBlOTZyZTc5bVZHZjN6M09LeGZuLURWaER1X2Z0OGhlOU55NnRwWjhjdEgzZw)]
- **欧洲电池产能危机**：bestmag报道欧洲面临“搁浅电池产能”问题，大量规划产能因需求不及预期和成本高企而面临闲置。[[Europe’s stranded battery capacity crisis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE85QzFZbjB5dFQxaEZKWnphand0QlVjSTJINHB6S0VPT0dGNHBPb2JJOExUazJzTWswWUlHcDNYRGlDdWw0eTlVVjVCSHdlMXJ5Z3ZaU2Fab1dTam0ySkUyT0Y3UzFxT3BJQTgzeF8wbGpiSGRxRlE)]

**收束**：欧洲经济在能源冲击与绿色转型之间艰难平衡，ECB政策工具箱持续向气候倾斜，而电池产业的结构性过剩值得警惕。下周关注欧元区PMI初值及ECB官员讲话。
欧洲经济.en:
European equities erased early losses, with the CAC 40 rallying to 8,372.28. The ECB issued several important communications, while geopolitical tensions raised energy security questions. 
- ECB Chief Economist Philip R. Lane gave an outlook for the euro area economy, and the ECB announced the leadership of its monetary policy task forces, signaling a continued push to modernize policy frameworks. [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260724~d484b483b9.en.pdf) | [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)
- The ECB extended climate factors in its collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims, reinforcing its green finance agenda. [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)
- Bitcoin is now fighting the ECB’s €51.8 billion bond wall for a shrinking pool of capital, as tighter monetary conditions squeeze speculative assets. [CryptoSlate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQT2d1ZXRxQW1Qb2hGTkRjdjU4VHhPX3FaY0hpcEJ3M2M3UGYtVGstSEdFR1RoSF9zdXV1RnRyZ2c3Q1BwZWhLXy16V1BNajVQQjNkcXpmaTdreFBadE1RM05JSjExZ1QwUVlvS3BhMjNKdUcyYkdHMzNWam5lczgzRF9wNmM3ZURqT1ZZRENBd3hvMTJHb3lyYmhSaUdPVGExVDRQMV9zSTdRcER1T0h6RGQ3NA)
- Greece emerged as Chinese platforms’ best market in the EU, highlighting the growing digital trade link between China and Europe. [eKathimerini](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQR1hJdktnejM2LTBPRjZ3SEQtSVNkajlHUG1XTUF6VVJUckZyUTVIRWpGMHl4MjN1QURWS1AydUdhbXMwYVlFUU9lSXNwS2JZMlhfeDBvQXNjZEdiOVZxMWpiU0R3WUhFS0Q2WllWSXBlOTZyZTc5bVZHZjN6M09LeGZuLURWaER1X2Z0OGhlOU55NnRwWjhjdEgzZw)
- A piece on Europe’s stranded battery capacity crisis raises concerns about industrial overcapacity and the region’s ability to compete in the EV supply chain. [bestmag](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE85QzFZbjB5dFQxaEZKWnphand0QlVjSTJINHB6S0VPT0dGNHBPb2JJOExUazJzTWswWUlHcDNYRGlDdWw0eTlVVjVCSHdlMXJ5Z3ZaU2Fab1dTam0ySkUyT0Y3UzFxT3BJQTgzeF8wbGpiSGRxRlE)

**Signal:** The ECB’s dual focus on climate and monetary policy modernization suggests a cautious tightening bias; energy-driven inflation from the Middle East could complicate the outlook.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区内讨论焦点集中在财务造假修正、内需辩论以及地产数据。华达科技因合并抵销错误虚增1.19亿元营收并更正三季报，引发对财务透明度的关注。北京二手房网签量维持低位，市场观望情绪浓厚。

- **华达科技更正去年三季报**：因合并抵销错误致虚增1.19亿元，公司发布更正公告，投资者质疑财务内控。[[合并抵销错误致虚增1.19亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9ma0ZSNE5fOEhITXd6NkdseUNVbzlndVNqbjdxVXZRSmJqSW9GMmo4OEhJeTN2YXJxU1d5a0R4Q2VJWGdwN1VVaTZYMGpaY1VoQ1BwWERUdUVGOW9Uc2VwZ2Nn)]
- **北京新房二手房网签数据**：7月25日新房236套、二手房691套，较前期变化不大，反映市场在政策真空期中的平淡。[[7月25日北京新房网签](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBTQ3FuVHV4TGhCUTlHM015b2h4aGhwUHBtdXBlUGRQMGxPSGhZbDhrdGhyYm02OUlkNzNuNE1KUkxMOWR4NVFEa2Fyemw5TnBJNmJwVWRLS0lXSVZsbVJjWTN3)]
- **“中国冲击2.0” vs “中国机遇2.0”**：社区文章驳斥外媒“中国冲击2.0”论，强调内需潜力。同时“内需疲软论”被指“一叶障目”。[[“中国冲击2.0”混淆视听](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5tbWt1TVpLSkVHTlp1cFpLWGhTdUNELWlzaEJiVG44M3kwUjV1MFpjRS1vSWlQanVPcE9TVUtsOTZXNmt2Z0swX0U2bUwtTzV0c2hPNURaQzEtNHV2emVjSw)] [[中国内需“疲软论”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1tc0lfS1RjeEdaMU0tOF9rQlZBVEdtbUNXQm02RG9xSDR1OG1vM2lCQnNZVkJWZnZ4anB5Yy1zN2lKQlplMmdoZlRPYVV4am8tMkNzczBnNHh3MHE5Ulphclh3)]
- **机构托管“信用租房”落地上海**：八成租客符合资质，租房市场出现新业态，社区讨论其对租金走势的影响。[[信用租房落地上海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9UblRZSGVYdjFVdzBLem1ZRXljWEhycl9GZHR3NWdSNVpYTVlIRFNpSlZRa1NSYjM5ZTE2dmh2d013SldWbVV4TzVUYXJpNDZTMEtvRDl1WmZXb01WMHY4YzZR)]

**收束**：社区情绪偏谨慎，财务事件与数据验证成为热点。后续关注华达科技是否引发更广泛财务审查，以及北京楼市是否出现政策微调。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor forums this cycle are fixated on accounting irregularities, domestic demand debates, and housing market stabilization. 
- Huada Technology corrected its Q3 2025 report after a consolidation error inflated revenue by 119 million yuan, drawing scrutiny from retail investors. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9ma0ZSNE5fOEhITXd6NkdseUNVbzlndVNqbjdxVXZRSmJqSW9GMmo4OEhJeTN2YXJxU1d5a0R4Q2VJWGdwN1VVaTZYMGpaY1VoQ1BwWERUdUVGOW9Uc2VwZ2Nn)
- The ‘China Shock 2.0 vs China Opportunity 2.0’ debate dominated commentary, with the latter gaining traction as a more constructive narrative for policy and markets. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5tbWt1TVpLSkVHTlp1cFpLWGhTdUNELWlzaEJiVG44M3kwUjV1MFpjRS1vSWlQanVPcE9TVUtsOTZXNmt2Z0swX0U2bUwtTzV0c2hPNURaQzEtNHV2emVjSw)
- Beijing’s real estate market data showed 236 new-home and 691 second-home online signings on July 25, providing a snapshot of housing demand. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBTQ3FuVHV4TGhCUTlHM015b2h4aGhwUHBtdXBlUGRQMGxPSGhZbDhrdGhyYm02OUlkNzNuNE1KUkxMOWR4NVFEa2Fyemw5TnBJNmJwVWRLS0lXSVZsbVJjWTN3)
- A ‘credit rental’ scheme launched in Shanghai via institutional trusteeship, with 80% of tenants reportedly qualifying, signaling innovation in the rental market. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9UblRZSGVYdjFVdzBLem1ZRXljWEhycl9GZHR3NWdSNVpYTVlIRFNpSlZRa1NSYjM5ZTE2dmh2d013SldWbVV4TzVUYXJpNDZTMEtvRDl1WmZXb01WMHY4YzZR)
- Kangxi Communication saw its deputy general manager and core technical staff resign with an annual salary of over 1.4 million yuan, sparking discussion on talent retention. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE93VGNrc3EyWGZFLUVuYVBrN2ZlT2otZjM1NVZ6WnBrbEhVakpFMkdnekZGX1gtT1Q5QlpxRWRnbnZLUWxRUUpxSU0yRGhQcDM2WTdsNHlhMGNUOGVNNFdSSzRn)

**Signal:** Community sentiment remains cautiously optimistic on policy support, but accounting scandals and tech sector churn point to selective risk awareness.

欧美.zh:
欧美板块以伊朗局势和南欧火灾为第一落点。胡塞武装宣称导弹袭击沙特，美军同日拦截伊朗油轮，海湾对抗加剧。法国与西班牙大火已迫使超30万人撤离，西班牙首相警告“复杂时刻”。此外，意大利儿童肥胖率成为健康政策警讯，左翼民主党在州选举中连胜但能否赢回蓝领选民仍存疑。

- [Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9d27v70j1o) — 胡塞武装称发射导弹命中沙特目标，美军宣布拦截一艘试图突破对伊封锁的油轮，双方动作不断升级。
- [More than 300,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le0d53y2o) — 波尔多附近20万人撤离，消防部门称火势未受控；西班牙北部火灾同样危急。
- [Pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein - how Italian children became so overweight](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c33y3151vydo) — WHO数据显示意大利5-9岁儿童超重率约36%，地中海饮食被廉价加工食品取代。
- [Left-wing Democrats are on a winning run - but can they lure back crucial swing voters?](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5y3rrd32jlo) — 民主党近期在深红州意外取胜，但能否在密歇根等关键州夺回工人阶级选票仍是问号。

欧美今日呈现出对外安全焦虑与对内社会结构痼疾并存的图景，未来关注伊朗封锁执行力度及欧洲极端天气常态化趋势。
欧美.en:
The Western desk is dominated by the intensifying Iran-linked conflict and catastrophic wildfires. The U.S.-Iran war continues to disrupt global shipping, while the Houthi missile claim adds a new dimension. Simultaneously, massive evacuations in France and Spain due to wildfires have become a humanitarian crisis. Political developments include a left-wing winning streak in U.S. special elections and Tunisia’s anti-government protests.

- **Iran-Houthi escalation**: Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia; U.S. disables a tanker evading the Iranian blockade ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9d27v70j1o)). Tehran summons Ukrainian diplomats after a Caspian Sea attack kills one sailor ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/26/iran-war-live-tehran-summons-ukraine-diplomats-over-caspian-sea-attack?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Wildfires force mass evacuations**: More than 300,000 flee blazes in France (near Bordeaux) and Spain. Spain’s PM warns of “complex hours” ahead ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le0d53y2o)). Al Jazeera reports 200,000 evacuated around Bordeaux alone ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/26/french-wildfires-trigger-mass-evacuations-around-bordeaux?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Left-wing Democratic wins**: A flurry of recent special election victories, but Michigan will test ability to win back working-class voters ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5y3rrd32jlo)).
- **Tunisia protests**: Thousands rally marking five years of emergency rule, calling for President Saied to step down ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/26/tunisians-mark-fifth-year-of-emergency-rule-with-calls-for-saied-to-go?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Ukraine drone strikes hit Russian e-commerce**: Attacks on Wildberries warehouses hurt small businesses and consumers, showing war’s civilian toll ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/25/nx-s1-5905377/ukraine-drone-strikes-on-wildberries-warehouses-hit-russian-sellers-consumers)).

Signal: The wildfire crisis and the Iran war will continue to dominate headlines, with climate change and geopolitical risk intersecting.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块出现双向流动：日本女性非母职生活方式引发社会讨论，韩国旅游消费创历史新高；北朝鲜替代经济报道揭露制裁下的生存政治。同时，日本初步裁定中国和韩国钢铁存在倾销行为，可能引贸易摩擦。

- [Out of the shadows: Japanese women building a life beyond motherhood](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQWF9adHJNdmJXWldyVUZRNThoT1Q4eWIybmhiSExqMHBlQ2RTcUFmNzdBUmJuTWdpRlUxUnQ2aC0ycXhveExReVBCTDJaTkJrVkJIalhBc0dSTU16bnZPdUtXN084QlJSNHY0RU5YTjFWZGVUYmYtMTRNLVl0SldWRTNPSUg5UUx2) — 越来越多的日本女性选择不婚不育，在职场和兴趣中寻找价值，冲击传统“母职”观念。
- [South Korea’s Tourism Hits Record Spending, Logs Visitors Growth](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNRmpJMHE5bExMUV9mVTgtUmFWUFNzOW15emItejc1cmFWYVNIWkE5V0FybjFFU0NnRGJWYmlXc2tONEJxdnpUV0E3dVVqdlRjTnFqNUJaVDJ5T0VVLUVLQlBqYVJpYkZqaktOejBfeHg0eXdlamtvZDViOURlV0FzLTlvaFI5ZGFZclNvR1l4a3N0UzFkUjNSUmZfR1V3cndoVkJic3pMaHM5Rjd2Tm95c2JEdDlTWkU5YjBmOHQ0Nkc4V3Zndnc0cA) — 韩国上半年入境游客数与旅游支出均破纪录，日韩关系缓和推动消费反弹。
- [Coffee-less coffee and chocolates without cocoa ― survival and politics of North Korea subsitute economy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9MbWdDVzJ4SHltVFpLczZUZHJVMnhfc3dfTTZabDItUkg2bkJzNTEwYjFJZVFRUklwX3pUd09RM3hpZDVIV05mQ0hQR3ZMQXh0TElPSC1DNA) — 北朝鲜用烤谷物替代咖啡、用植物脂替代可可，替代经济反映了制裁下的韧性及政治控制。
- [Japan tentatively rules China, S. Korea steel items sold at dumped prices](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNbnJrNFVERE5KNzVNc294X1MyeGNFTEVBUHA1TWZMOGdPQ05nc2R4YnR6bkNGTXFmWWZ5RHdoWkd0ZS1QMld5anFXTDd6NFdLUWRCUmZTMUcwR096dXd2YmhKcFdBeW80MUpxT09ja0ZDRFBmZEtIYkJBMkRpdHR0anpLR2pjS0xKemc2TFNVWFdzOWdPNDZzeE43SUdxZ3h2Z0xsUVhVUzlVV2NDbkNxMkFNWQ) — 日本经济产业省初步裁定中韩钢铁倾销，可能加征关税，影响东亚产业链。

日韩社会在人口结构、消费模式与地缘贸易间呈现多样化张力，后续关注日本女性运动政策响应及中日韩钢铁贸易争端走向。
日韩.en:
Japan and Korea see a mix of geopolitical tensions, economic recovery, and social change. Ukraine presses Japan to supply Patriot missiles despite pacifist constraints, while Japanese consumption of Korean goods rebounds. South Korea's tourism hits record spending, and Japan tentatively rules Chinese and South Korean steel as dumped. Socially, the 'invisible women' in Japan’s sauna culture and the rise of non-motherhood choices are gaining attention.

- **Ukraine seeks Japanese Patriot missiles**: Kyiv insists Japan’s pacifist constitution permits the aid, a delicate diplomatic push ([South China Morning Post](https://news.google.)).
- **Japanese consumption rebounds in Korea**: The ‘No Japan’ boycott fades, leading to a recovery in Japanese product sales in South Korea ([Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOQ0d3amdreXBpQ1VBZ2xLM3BaS0wxT1Aybi11MnJfM0ZCWF94eVBsVnhIQmwxUk8tMlQ1N2VrZTcwWHo4NTFJaC1RTHpTd3JrbjZKWmozVjd6QUpmUkl2NVF4cVpld2h4T1cxR2g5MTV3eFplM3MxRlZ0QmY3cXVaM3BCbkRUUjFBdUVkclQyTFZnaUdiM1IxSWpxTHJjaVk)).
- **South Korea tourism record**: Record spending and visitor growth, driven by improved relations and pent-up demand ([Outlook Respawn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNRmpJMHE5bExMUV9mVTgtUmFWUFNzOW15emItejc1cmFWYVNIWkE5V0FybjFFU0NnRGJWYmlXc2tONEJxdnpUV0E3dVVqdlRjTnFqNUJaVDJ5T0VVLUVLQlBqYVJpYkZqaktOejBfeHg0eXdlamtvZDViOURlV0FzLTlvaFI5ZGFZclNvR1l4a3N0UzFkUjNSUmZfR1V3cndoVkJic3pMaHM5Rjd2Tm95c2JEdDlTWkU5YjBmOHQ0Nkc4V3Zndnc0cA)).
- **Japan rules China, S. Korea steel dumped**: Tentative anti-dumping decision could escalate trade frictions ([Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNbnJrNFVERE5KNzVNc294X1MyeGNFTEVBUHA1TWZMOGdPQ05nc2R4YnR6bkNGTXFmWWZ5RHdoWkd0ZS1QMld5anFXTDd6NFdLUWRCUmZTMUcwR096dXd2YmhKcFdBeW80MUpxT09ja0ZDRFBmZEtIYkJBMkRpdHR0anpLR2pjS0xKemc2TFNVWFdzOWdPNDZzeE43SUdxZ3h2Z0xsUVhVUzlVV2NDbkNxMkFNWQ)).
- **Japanese women building life beyond motherhood**: A feature on the growing number of women choosing child-free lives, challenging traditional norms ([The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQWF9adHJNdmJXWldyVUZRNThoT1Q4eWIybmhiSExqMHBlQ2RTcUFmNzdBUmJuTWdpRlUxUnQ2aC0ycXhveExReVBCTDJaTkJrVkJIalhBc0dSTU16bnZPdUtXN084QlJSNHY0RU5YTjFWZGVUYmYtMTRNLVl0SldWRTNPSUg5UUx2)).

Signal: Watch for Japan’s final ruling on steel dumping and Ukraine’s efforts to secure Japanese military aid, both of which could reshape regional alliances.

中国.zh:
中国板块以高层教育部署、国防工业展示、社会文化事件为核心。总书记对基础教育工作提出明确要求，强调立德树人；第十六届中国航展将于12月开幕，多款新型装备将集中亮相；外卖员王计兵诗集获鲁迅文学奖，代表蓝领文学进入主流视野。广州因教育实力与城市磁力成为大学生第一城，体现人才竞争格局变化。

- [焦点访谈丨未来基础教育工作怎样做 总书记提出明确要求](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE4xSlpsRHFvcFhmX3hVTmhodTl3QmNvT3hHTWtnQVRZUXV3OFBFTlhlcUE4M1FtU01Gam43RFJXVHB3VHRNc0FYUXBGYlBFREdOWVVUdk9zNk9MNXlSa1FaOUk1WXhUWk1GcGMxNVZYMzI5dw) — 习近平在中央政治局会议上就基础教育改革提出要求，涉及减负、公平与师资建设。
- [早安太空 · 网罗天下 | 第十六届中国航展12月7日开幕 多款新型装备将集中亮相](https://news.google.) — 航展将展出新一代隐身战斗机、大型无人机等，体现国防科技进展。
- [微言微语 - 中国外卖员王计兵诗集获中国最高文学奖 从蓝领工人文学作品一窥中国庞大零工经济景况 - RFI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — 外卖员王计兵以诗集《赶时间的人》获得鲁迅文学奖，成为零工经济时代首位获此殊荣的蓝领诗人。
- [广州因何能成中国大学生第一城 教育实力与城市磁力共舞](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9rUlI0eW5scDdHTmtDWVQybnVaMDZLZkhMdXZxMC1sUUM0Z2tQSE4wU2Q1RmF1Z292Z2NqRzcwMGZSSzVCeUYwVE13QjlLR0VWb1NFYTN5bXVkZFJCcTgtZF8wai1XZVdrdVp1dGpySEM) — 广州在校大学生数量全国第一，反映其高校聚集与人才吸引力。

中国社会在政策导向与民间创新间保持活跃，教育公平、国防现代化和蓝领文化崛起是当日三大看点。
中国.en:
China’s education system is in the spotlight with President Xi’s new directives on basic education and a major academic conference on higher education management. Meanwhile, the country pushes back against ‘weak domestic demand’ narratives, and a delivery-driver poet wins a top literary prize. The 16th China Airshow is set for December, showcasing new military hardware.

- **Xi Jinping on basic education**: A CCTV news program details the President’s requirements for future basic education, emphasising a solid foundation for national rejuvenation ([央视](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE4xSlpsRHFvcFhmX3hVTmhodTl3QmNvT3hHTWtnQVRZUXV3OFBFTlhlcUE4M1FtU01Gam43RFJXVHB3VHRNc0FYUXBGYlBFREdOWVVUdk9zNk9MNXlSa1FaOUk1WXhUWk1GcGMxNVZYMzI5dw)).
- **Foreign exchange and cultural exchange**: Chinese students visited Malaysia’s parliament, meeting ministers ([新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9pSm94cVhqVW1vdE1DQnVQZl82Q0VwVXlOYTRmSmJIY0x1X1JvajU1ZDNoZWpkeWxoQkpYYjhSQUFHdEpXZWRrcmh5RTAtOHNaNlBDeVdTeW5udjAzT2hmQUt5Z0plMU9PZVk1cjdtaGppLVVMSUtEcjk3bUJ4b1U)).
- **Delivery driver wins literary prize**: Wang Jibing’s poetry collection won China’s top literary award, highlighting the gig economy and blue-collar voices ([RFI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)).
- **China Airshow announced**: The 16th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition will open December 7, featuring new equipment ([finance.sina.com.cn](https://news.google.)).
- **Refuting ‘weak demand’ narrative**: Official media argues that claims of weak domestic demand are ‘one leaf obscuring the mountain’, citing growth in emerging sectors ([新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNX2tNYXRTelU0S01ab3ZHZHFjbXRFRk5kcWY1TlBMdHVxbzVtNGM4OFo3REFGZzlzMTVtai1aTE8wYVdNQXNxb0VvVWRPQmQ5LWdzYnhHRUk0ZFh4bFU1UFhPQ0lnYWo5U0NtWW1NT0FaTVNtMWpmcWhmeFU4TVMxeVFmcXdfWGhuaC1pWg)).

Signal: Expect more education reform announcements ahead of the 20th Party Congress, and watch for the airshow as a platform for military modernization messaging.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日的最大话题是数学家邓煜获得菲尔兹奖后的讨论。用户不仅关注其学术成就，更对他的个人生活——写诗、看球、读科幻——产生浓厚兴趣，折射出知识精英“接地气”的一面。两篇相关文章都强调这位年轻学者的多元兴趣。

- [菲尔兹奖之后，人们在知乎重新认识邓煜 - thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE51UUtFY0ktazVUUEkwb0VaOW9BczFvZUtodFluRlBoS1ZhNzhqaWc1Z3NuUGc4dkVTeUJBRXlYX3NIMm1kaUo0RFJ3d20zNWhiMnh1Y2pGUlNxUlNuam1udEpnNEg4NGNlM1k3UGhNUmhxQQ) — 知乎上大量回答回溯邓煜的学术路径及生活轶事，高赞回复称“看到了知识的温度”。
- [邓煜：闲暇写诗看球读科幻 - finance.sina.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNSTdRVnh0dVRrRnpBQkxaUXZLSG5QQmhKYXpoLVJFZjNOV0lsaVR5OFF2a2lXMmpWNG03d0xIQ0s4MUsyWXBoNEkzdEh3amxvTXNjYUZ2THdLaEZNWENkWnZjRUgwOVBmZG9fN2pnSnh2dXFpb0JoeVZIdnBDR3lGSmY1OGRaNXAxSXI1NEZPOFk0Yy10TEk1cjVqN3EzRklncXJnZ0JXLUQtMzZraFQ4UlBBdVZwbEs3X1YzLUU3M0tHN2xvcHc) — 专访透露邓煜在数学研究之外保持文学爱好，他本人表示“科幻和诗歌帮助我理解抽象结构”。

知乎用户通过邓煜案例再次讨论“天才的养成”与“科研与生活平衡”，社区氛围趋于理性和包容，这是高质量知识社区生态的体现。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community dynamics revolve around the recent Fields Medal winner Deng Yu, sparking renewed interest in his life and work. Two posts highlight his multidisciplinary interests and the public’s rediscovery after the award.

- **‘Rediscoving Deng Yu’**: After the Fields Medal, people on Zhihu are learning about his background, including his hobbies of poetry, football, and sci-fi ([thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE51UUtFY0ktazVUUEkwb0VaOW9BczFvZUtodFluRlBoS1ZhNzhqaWc1Z3NuUGc4dkVTeUJBRXlYX3NIMm1kaUo0RFJ3d20zNWhiMnh1Y2pGUlNxUlNuam1udEpnNEg4NGNlM1k3UGhNUmhxQQ)).
- **Deng Yu’s personal side**: An interview titled ‘Leisure time writing poetry, watching football, reading sci-fi’ gives a glimpse into the mathematician’s personality ([finance.sina.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNSTdRVnh0dVRrRnpBQkxaUXZLSG5QQmhKYXpoLVJFZjNOV0lsaVR5OFF2a2lXMmpWNG03d0xIQ0s4MUsyWXBoNEkzdEh3amxvTXNjYUZ2THdLaEZNWENkWnZjRUgwOVBmZG9fN2pnSnh2dXFpb0JoeVZIdnBDR3lGSmY1OGRaNXAxSXI1NEZPOFk0Yy10TEk1cjVqN3EzRklncXJnZ0JXLUQtMzZraFQ4UlBBdVZwbEs3X1YzLUU3M0tHN2xvcHc)).

Signal: The Zhihu community continues to serve as a platform for intellectual celebrity culture, and Deng Yu’s award may inspire more deep-dive discussions about Chinese mathematicians.

国际安全.zh:
24小时内，国际安全重心从美伊正面冲突转向乌克兰-伊朗在里海的直接摩擦。美国因拦截导弹库存不足暂缓对伊大规模打击，但胡塞武装在红海重启对沙特船只的封锁。
- [乌克兰一夜之间在俄罗斯和里海发动大规模打击](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOSVExZUI1X1hkVVp4YUpHaDRFdS1VcER6dTVKX1U1RHlIMzBKX0IyZHU3clR0a21sVHUxa193VkdpSnFhb3dIcTFrQnBQWFc1dXNxMk41SzZJTGpzOU9RbGtEdUd5NG9MZm5zVWRZdUNzUDA0RnNaczNjTl9pTTRpMkZqaEV2ZWszSDQ2alBuVUk1MGlkQlNpTEo3RWV1R3RHT2c5SFgxcUw)：乌军称取得“非常好的战果”，摧毁防空系统、军舰及后勤设施。
- [伊朗声称在15天内摧毁了11架美国飞机和爱国者系统](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE95MmFQWU41d1pOelRuNWtKT3ZPQ3BSNXVic2VHelhMM3N0a2dubk9KRmFrWlpLa1VSNE5QZlNxSVBFQVAxTlVWMGxYTDVYX3hXS0E)：此说法缺乏独立证实，但显示伊朗试图提升宣传战果。
- [希腊防空系统在沙特拦截来自也门的导弹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9ianZzQl9mdjU0MXBLYjZiMm5PQTcycDh0dHAyb2d6cmhOZThvY2hvUjNsVE96Q1J3ZHg2NDFwYTE0bUxkcTVOZlNSck52MUFtOXVyejJtWUl3TXhmZTZ4M2JTWDhFbUttVFE)：欧洲国家正在介入中东防空，但未参与对伊朗打击。
- [专家怀疑“大规模”美国攻击能否击溃伊朗](https://news.google.)：内部认知分歧表明美国并未准备好全面战争。

国际安全领域正呈现“一热一冷”的格局：乌克兰-伊朗冲突线骤然升温，而美伊正面战线暂时冷却，但红海航运继续承压。
国际安全.en:
The global security landscape is defined by a multi-front escalation involving Ukraine, Iran, and Yemen. While the US-Iran direct confrontation appears to pause, the conflict is spreading to the Caspian Sea and Red Sea, with second-order effects on energy shipping and alliance politics.

- **Ukraine hits Russian ships carrying Iranian arms in Caspian** – President Zelensky confirmed strikes on a Russian warship and vessels with Iran-linked cargo, part of a wave of long-range attacks ([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE5KRFpsbkJ0X0RsMFlhU0Q1SG5CVE1CLWdIdzI3cjZVS3lxTXNvdlBJTDZhUlJRaEoxVWlGTkhLaEd2eU10TDNGRG5jZw)).
- **Iran claims destruction of 11 US aircraft, Patriot systems** – Tehran's propaganda arm boasts of 15 days of strikes, though the claim remains unverified and likely inflated ([ایران اینترنشنال](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE95MmFQWU41d1pOelRuNWtKT3ZPQ3BSNXVic2VHelhMM3N0a2dubk9KRmFrWlpLa1VSNE5QZlNxSVBFQVAxTlVWMGxYTDVYX3hXS0E)).
- **Pentagon interceptor shortage constrains US options** – A warning from the Pentagon led Trump to hold off on major escalation, a rare admission of readiness gaps that shapes near-term strategy ([Ynetnews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9ncTZXUkVoSjloQV9idHF3NDdhcGJZN2RpdVM5b1dKUmFXUDdGT0ZwOXdaYkNCLVZXOWdKUXM2Vmp3aWV1cE00SWVWYUl5eWdya2RYeGtsVQ)).
- **Greek system intercepts missiles from Yemen** – A Greek-operated defense system in Saudi Arabia successfully stopped Houthi projectiles, showcasing allied integration ([Jerusalem Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9ianZzQl9mdjU0MXBLYjZiMm5PQTcycDh0dHAyb2d6cmhOZThvY2hvUjNsVE96Q1J3ZHg2NDFwYTE0bUxkcTVOZlNSck52MUFtOXVyejJtWUl3TXhmZTZ4M2JTWDhFbUttVFE)).

**Signal**: The convergence of the Ukraine-Russia and Iran-US-Israel conflicts via the Caspian Sea suggests a dangerous new vector for escalation that the Pentagon may not be fully prepared to manage.

冲突局势.zh:
冲突局势最爆炸性的进展是乌克兰对里海伊朗船只的袭击，导致伊朗发出直接军事威胁。这一事件可能将乌克兰战争与中东乱局更紧密地捆绑。
- [乌克兰袭击里海伊朗关联船只，增大地区风险](https://news.google.)：朝鲜日报称此举“激化更大区域风险”。
- [伊朗外长威胁基辅“所有乌克兰都在射程内”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNbWpsV1FHQnRnc2xZY0U0NWtFbTR4cVFOZDl2V2pXTU8weDZJaUlWdFNZc3Z1NWE1d2NkLTVfZmNCTWo4LUN0dy1wZElyT3Jaa3pVZ2JZVkszSFpkNjVWNmo0b0RnUld4TkpSSnVrVS10RTVrUUg1TnBadUVhcVFEQW5Mc21CMUNVd05vSjg2Q05FLVBUdjlKcHlmaE9oTC1TMW8tRWJSN25sWlpjc0d3)：这标志着伊朗可能首次对乌克兰领土实施远程打击。
- [泽连斯基确认打击俄军舰和运载伊朗货物的船只](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFBOdjRza3IzWmdTTFc3SWgwN3JQZUJtQy1VQV9SM0tsNGlYTHcyRVFYaEtmRHpVZWVhS0dYNzhhZGVGMWlzYy10eTIwX05ybkdrdkprYVY0YVpDYmk4XzVz)：乌方首次公开承认此类行动，有高度政治含义。
- [胡塞武装攻击沙特石油设施，伊朗呼吁对话](https://news.google.)：也门战场重新成为焦点，伊朗同时释放谈判信号，显示其战略纵深。

冲突的交叉升级成为最大变数：乌克兰打击伊朗船只将伊朗直接拖入欧亚战局，而胡塞对沙特石油的攻击则保持对美以的压力。
冲突局势.en:
The immediate conflict zone is centered on the Caspian Sea and Red Sea, with a notable de-escalation in the Persian Gulf. Iran has shifted from direct confrontation with the US to threatening Ukraine, while Houthi forces intensify attacks on Saudi Arabia.

- **Iran warns Ukraine after Caspian strike kills sailor** – The Iranian foreign minister threatened Kyiv with ballistic missiles, stating all of Ukraine is within range ([New York Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNbWpsV1FHQnRnc2xZY0U0NWtFbTR4cVFOZDl2V2pXTU8weDZJaUlWdFNZc3Z1NWE1d2NkLTVfZmNCTWo4LUN0dy1wZElyT3Jaa3pVZ2JZVkszSFpkNjVWNmo0b0RnUld4TkpSSnVrVS10RTVrUUg1TnBadUVhcVFEQW5Mc21CMUNVd05vSjg2Q05FLVBUdjlKcHlmaE9oTC1TMW8tRWJSN25sWlpjc0d3)).
- **Ukraine says vessels hit were carrying Iranian military cargo** – Zelensky's confirmation ties the strike directly to Iran's support for Russia, blurring the lines between the two conflicts ([Jerusalem Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFBOdjRza3IzWmdTTFc3SWgwN3JQZUJtQy1VQV9SM0tsNGlYTHcyRVFYaEtmRHpVZWVhS0dYNzhhZGVGMWlzYy10eTIwX05ybkdrdkprYVY0YVpDYmk4XzVz)).
- **Houthis attack Saudi oil sites, Iran calls for dialogue** – Amid the Houthi blockade, Iran paradoxically calls for talks while its proxies escalate ([The News Pakistan](https://news.google.)).
- **Ukraine detains organizer of defense event hit by Russian missile** – A missile strike on a defense industry gathering killed 10, leading to negligence charges, highlighting vulnerability of rear areas ([Euromaidan Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQaGg2dGx0VExEVm90QlJRYkRjcEJYVm1UVXIxTndmSjhIbmhScW8wQkljc05oNkU2aFBiSGVuVzRGMnR4UG10NC1YSGROcGdtQmZEV0VselcxcGd6SzV0dk1WeTRLR3dnS3YxX0tlNEUyNVBCSkRHX1pQUi1yNFFZMEpyQThEb01SWGtsNTNZNHMtS2gwaHliNTJvcnh5ZXJZbkJOUExCTzVZeXpYUUdma1p6bGF5RlJR)).

**Signal**: Iran's threatened ballistic missile attack on Ukraine would mark a major escalation beyond the current theater, potentially pulling in NATO air defenses.

中国军情.zh:
中国军情方面，南海局势持续升温，中国驻菲大使措辞强硬；同时随着日本陆上自卫队首次派往南海，中国出动航母回应。美国将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”引发中方抗议。
- [马科斯在南海挑衅却遭特朗普“背刺”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPRkZOd2RkajVmR20zbVpIVnZ0cXZWT1kzRFR3dFpqejQ4ZElQOWtuWmI4RGRRcDdGT2drcFphMG9NLTVCX1dUWWJqY25CLUdXWlpRbXdrVFg5dDJHN19ZWGkyR3U5Um1TTlZlVktYTDc4OXdaRjdCOFFueXJWeHhGT3AwQnBON3BXMy1nRA)：分析指菲律宾误判美国支持，实际特朗普更关注伊朗问题。
- [中国驻菲律宾大使“坚决怼回去！坚决打回去！”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1fam9nRkhZVERBVURMUHBsUHlZZFVqWnBGeFpaVndQUmFYcUtnQzYxRVNpZDB2RWk2WTRYdDFrRG5KaDZiUlI0ckh0RkdaT3g0NkkyRVp6V3MtVE9vaGg3eUVvN0ZvcTBiN2NIMGFkV1U3NWNqOEpfNw)：这是近年来少有的直接军事措辞，显示中方底线。
- [日本陆上自卫队首次派遣至南海，中国出动航母](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3)：美日同盟在南海的军事存在显著增强。
- [美将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)：商务部回应，此举或为新一轮制裁铺垫。

中国军情显示，南海争端已进入“军事对弈”阶段，中方采取航母部署和外交警告双管齐下，但美日方面也在加强介入。
中国军情.en:
Tensions in the South China Sea continue to rise as the Philippines challenges Chinese claims and Japan deploys troops for the first time. China responds with carrier movements and strong diplomatic language, while analysts note both sides understand each other's red lines.

- **Philippines surprised by Trump's stance amid South China Sea provocations** – Manila's aggressive posture clashes with US reluctance to fully back its claims, as Trump prioritizes other fronts ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPRkZOd2RkajVmR20zbVpIVnZ0cXZWT1kzRFR3dFpqejQ4ZElQOWtuWmI4RGRRcDdGT2drcFphMG9NLTVCX1dUWWJqY25CLUdXWlpRbXdrVFg5dDJHN19ZWGkyR3U5Um1TTlZlVktYTDc4OXdaRjdCOFFueXJWeHhGT3AwQnBON3BXMy1nRA)).
- **China deploys aircraft carrier in response to Japanese GSDF deployment** – For the first time, Japan sends ground troops to the South China Sea, prompting a Chinese naval response in a sign of escalating military competition ([朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNWEs3UXRYaVluZ3dYbXc4RnVNUTFSYVItMTd0bGRQRVdoYjd0ZUw5UmJTaDF5UTBqbnBCY1QtUVJzemJnbHdqX1RaWDVSNmdGUUFwclVISzRlNFFoUlhRV3JKSER2R2dUbVhLdUFKLWU5VFl2WVhLY2FoMzkycS10azhOcjFHTk1zX2VUWlh3)).
- **Chinese ambassador to Philippines vows to 'hit back'** – In a rare direct threat, Ambassador Huang Xilian stated China will 'resolutely fight back' against Philippine provocations, raising the risk of a naval clash ([新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1fam9nRkhZVERBVURMUHBsUHlZZFVqWnBGeFpaVndQUmFYcUtnQzYxRVNpZDB2RWk2WTRYdDFrRG5KaDZiUlI0ckh0RkdaT3g0NkkyRVp6V3MtVE9vaGg3eUVvN0ZvcTBiN2NIMGFkV1U3NWNqOEpfNw)).
- **US adds Chinese firms to military blacklist, China protests** – The Pentagon's latest 'China Military Company' list draws a sharp response from Beijing, further complicating trade ties ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)).

**Signal**: The South China Sea is becoming a three-way flashpoint among China, Philippines, and Japan, with the US distracted by Middle East crises, potentially emboldening Chinese assertive moves.

海军与印太.zh:
印太海军动态突出两大信号：一是美军在环太军演中实战化测试乌克兰式自杀无人艇，标志着海战革命向无人化演进；二是美国海军力推低成本远程导弹采购，意图应对高端消耗战。
- [美国海军在太平洋SINKEX中使用“乌克兰式”自杀无人艇](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/u-s-navy-deploys-ukraine-style-kamikaze-sea-drones-during-pacific-sinkex/)：由两个无人水面攻击艇（USV）在鱼叉和LRASM导弹命中后，对佩莱利乌号水线实施爆破，完美复刻乌军战术。
- [美国海军订购低成本导弹扩大舰队及盟友远程打击能力](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)：CHAOS项目选择CoAspire公司，旨在为盟友提供可负担的海上打击弹药。
- [霍尔木兹海峡通行量降至低位，胡塞恢复红海攻击](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)：美伊对峙导致中东海上咽喉几近瘫痪。
- [USNI新闻西太平洋脉搏：罗斯福号领衔RIMPAC多国编队](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-24-2026)：演习内容包含击沉两艘退役舰艇，检验多弹种协同反舰能力。
- [白宫抗议国会禁止购买外国军舰的提案](https://news.USNI.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)：反映美国造船业产能不足与前沿需求的矛盾。

海军与印太板块显示，美国正通过无人技术与低成本弹药重塑海上力量对比，同时面临中东护航与西太平洋双重压力，快速造船能力成为短板。
海军与印太.en:
The US Navy is actively testing new drone capabilities and addressing procurement challenges while monitoring the Western Pacific and Middle East. RIMPAC 2026 showcases allied interoperability, but the Hormuz crisis and Houthi attacks demonstrate the fragility of global chokepoints.

- **US Navy uses kamikaze sea drones in SINKEX during RIMPAC** – Two one-way attack USVs hit the ex-USS Peleliu at the waterline, demonstrating a new tactical concept learned from Ukraine ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/u-s-navy-deploys-ukraine-style-kamikaze-sea-drones-during-pacific-sinkex/)).
- **CHAOS program selects CoAspire for low-cost cruise missiles** – The Navy aims to field affordable long-range strike weapons for both its fleet and allied navies, expanding distributed lethality ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)).
- **Hormuz transits plummet as US-Iran strikes continue** – Only 78 transits recorded in a week versus 174 the previous week, underscoring the economic impact of the conflict ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)).
- **White House opposes congressional ban on foreign warship purchases** – The OMB argues that restrictive NDAA language could hamper Navy shipbuilding at a time of high demand ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)).

**Signal**: The Navy is innovating tactically (drones) and procurement-wise (foreign ships, low-cost missiles) to counter both peer threats in the Pacific and asymmetric challenges in the Middle East, but industrial constraints remain a critical vulnerability.

汽车.zh:
汽车板块今日焦点集中在中国车企的全球化阵痛与自动驾驶安全证据的角力。比亚迪全球销量虽已超越福特，但本土市场收缩正在侵蚀利润率，提醒投资者不要被海外数字迷住双眼。Waymo获得IIHS的第三方安全背书，事故率比人类低68%，但数据局限在有限地理区域内。特斯拉FSD的白内障安全声明则遭到联邦监管机构质疑，自动驾驶的双轨叙事（科技公司高调宣称 vs 监管要求实据）仍在持续。

- [BYD Already Surpassed Ford, and It's Only Now Revving Up Ambitions. Here's How It Can Win](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPalRvWllpT0pjWkdDMVJ3RTM3ck9mQTRIUHBCN1ppdEJKYWY1SThRX1NYZUF4SXVwMUhpUUFyYVFLVGRZY2hreEF3TzFQQ1I5VXEwQ1RGc3E4S1dvaXdmZUh3UTJZZU5oRWV1bW03VUxDZm5iZUE1OEEyTGR4R3d1Ukg4S1FuSTBYZVRqZk5kdzdZU3Nv) ——比亚迪已超越福特，但需警惕国内利润滑坡。
- [Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/waymo-is-2-3-safer-than-a-human-driver-says-iihs-with-some-caveats/) ——IIHS数据为Waymo提供重要背书，但“部分道路、好天气”等限制条件意味着通用化仍需时日。
- [Tesla Said FSD Can Handle Whiteouts. Now Federal Regulators Want Receipts](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPVVhwV2xNc2M5WGpiRlJSNVNvWUdnWE9OQ3F2TEpyTUhNcC1mUWlNcVlwZHZuTG5oZWdxdFhFN0o1Y084dWlXUWRKQnJoQVZhamdVU09KaDNSMm56Y3o2MXEtZ0hDTjQ0Z3dGbF9jRktXZ20zM2QzLW5zWXI2OUhjMXZlX21mQWlRNk9HcGhyLTd4bU9qUWNVZVhqcGdfZjVMN3VlMw) ——特斯拉声称FSD能应对白茫茫雪盲，但联邦监管机构要求拿出证据，信任危机加剧。

整体来看，汽车行业正经历从“卖车故事”到“安全数据”的叙事切换，自动驾驶公司必须用更严谨的第三方验证来消除公众疑虑。
汽车.en:
The automotive desk is dominated by BYD's contrasting fortunes—global expansion versus domestic margin pressure—and new data on autonomous driving safety. Waymo's IIHS-backed safety claim is tempered by operational caveats, while Tesla faces regulatory pushback over FSD marketing. The electric truck and micromobility segments also see notable developments.

- [BYD's Global Sales Surge Masks a Home-Market Contraction That's Hitting Margins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOOWN1eEpzVGIzMnRkRnAzVjZEdnZiV2dxc29lbW15Ykt1VllrQ2RKQVFmSWtiT3l6VjVjMW94dGhGVHBNMVd3WXdEdm43WF84NDBFYVVGUzJDbkJ1OVlUNVM3WXQxcE9FbXJYcG9OZVdncS1TZl9ieUtrTDNYYUxYXzR3ZWx0NzVoRm5jc2tJNDRWMWp5MzdkUUN0NHNlX2tRN2JHT0tjRzJUc0hWZTFvdl8wcnhkVHFLZGNNSmJaR0FfMVJsakZJQVlB) — BYD's global sales surge masks a home-market contraction hitting margins.
- [Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/waymo-is-2-3-safer-than-a-human-driver-says-iihs-with-some-caveats/) — Waymo's autonomous taxis are 68% safer than human drivers, but the data is limited to its operational area.
- [Tesla Said FSD Can Handle Whiteouts. Now Federal Regulators Want Receipts.](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPVVhwV2xNc2M5WGpiRlJSNVNvWUdnWE9OQ3F2TEpyTUhNcC1mUWlNcVlwZHZuTG5oZWdxdFhFN0o1OE84dWlXUWRKQnJoQVZhamdVU09KaDNSMm56Y3o2MXEtZ0hDTjQ0Z3dGbF9jRktXZ20zM2QzLW5zWXI2OUhjMXZlX21mQWlRNk9HcGhyLTd4bU9qUWNVZVhqcGdfZjVMN3VlMw) — Tesla's marketing claims attract federal scrutiny; regulators demand evidence.
- [Another state may legalize electric motorbikes up to 30 and 40 mph under sweeping new micromobility bill](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/another-state-may-legalize-electric-motorbikes-up-to-30-and-40-mph-under-sweeping-new-micromobility-bill/) — Massachusetts considers a broad micromobility framework that would legalize faster electric bikes and scooters.
- [Windrose says 10 of its electric semi trucks are coming to Texas’ I-35 corridor](https://electrek.co/2026/07/25/dsv-to-deploy-10-windrose-electric-semi-trucks-on-i-35-corridor-allegedly/) — A new electric Class 8 truck deployment on a key freight route, though caveats remain (allegedly).

**Signal:** The automotive sector is at a tipping point: EV leaders face domestic pressures, autonomy gains credibility but also regulatory heat, and micromobility legislation could reshape urban transport.

AI.zh:
AI板块今日弥漫着一种反身性焦虑：AI的开发者开始抗议AI的威胁，普通民众通过图书馆工作坊主动“逃避AI”，而资本仍在疯狂注入（Mistral计划30亿欧元融资）。硅谷内部的分裂与公众觉醒正在形成共振。谷歌发布Gemini 3.6 Flash，同时确认Pixel 11因AI数据中心导致的内存价格上涨而提价，硬件成本压力倒逼消费者买单。DeepSeek因泄密暂停融资，中国AI开源模型引发的“AI共产主义”恐慌在美国媒体中发酵。

- [Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/librarians-are-hosting-viral-avoiding-ai-workshops-for-people-who-are-fed-up-with-big-tech/) ——“逃避AI”工作坊爆红，反映出技术疲劳正在变成文化现象。
- [Musk: AI Will Surpass Human Intelligence Within Five Years, Urges Rivals to Set Aside Feuds and Build Safety Guardrails](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5uM0VWZ19MY2dTeWR6NmhETEk0cXI1TkxzNXg0QXhfb2oxWFdPM0Rxd3pkWjlFalhnYTc3d3NzX1JRVWhZcjNQQmNhZV8yN3ZiQjhSVk5oZG9IX1RNanltaUNSRDRSd3JGMmRzdzVKRVUyQkFwQVE) ——马斯克呼吁竞争对手搁置争斗共建护栏，但其自身公司xAI也在加速推进，言行矛盾明显。
- [Google Releases Gemini 3.6 Flash AI Model July 21](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9SdVpxX2l2eWxmV1JxelNfQnEtandOcHpGUk9YQ1BmQTBWM1pZaG9ndG5BUTM0X0xOSGhQNkszMVZJVmlMVmdvMjhNeGxfeTdmVWh1Zk9TM3FsYW0xUTRfQnM5cDcxVXBLMHpjNjZ3) ——谷歌快速迭代Gemini，表明模型军备竞赛仍未减速。
- [Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971041/google-confirms-pixel-11-price-hike) ——AI数据中心需求推高RAM价格，消费者最终为AI红利买单。

AI领域正进入一个诡异阶段：技术加速推进，但社会接受度出现裂痕，资本仍在豪赌，下一阶段可能迎来更激进的监管反弹。
AI.en:
AI continues to stir intense debate and action. Public backlash is visible in 'Avoiding AI' workshops and protests by Silicon Valley workers who built the technology.
