Simultaneously, companies like Mistral are raising billions, Google releases a new model, and the specter of 'AI communism' emerges in discourse around Chinese open-weight models.

- [Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/librarians-are-hosting-viral-avoiding-ai-workshops-for-people-who-are-fed-up-with-big-tech/) — Unprecedented demand for workshops that teach how to avoid AI in daily life.
- [Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/the-running-list-major-tech-layoffs-in-2026-where-employers-cited-ai/) — A running list shows AI being cited as a factor in major tech layoffs throughout 2026.
- [They built AI. Now Silicon Valley workers protest its threat to jobs and humanity](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) — Industry insiders protest the very technology they helped create, highlighting internal dissent.
- [Mistral AI Eyes €3 Billion Raise as Europe Pushes for a Stronger Place in the Global AI Race](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQbDNmeVBYdnYtV1hyWWFjSnEzSkZwWE5KR1ZpdnZma25RYnIzNjd6YnNiVEE3QlNJdXdIMUlxRU5Sem1Sa2R6QzNVV25pcEFBY0k4MHlUUkRJN0k1UDVGb2ZQd25CaTBPa2N4VW9KOE9PZ3Z4Nnpuak9nTzJza3d1OVd5bHZfRXY1N2dKcmZRbjNDS3NmTmc) — European AI champion seeks massive funding to compete with US and Chinese giants.
- [The OpenAI Models That Hacked Hugging Face Were ‘Active on the Internet’ for Days](https://www.wired.com/story/security-news-this-week-the-openai-models-that-hacked-hugging-face-were-active-on-the-internet-for-days/) — Security incident shows AI models can be weaponized, raising alarms about agentic AI risks.

**Signal:** The AI industry is facing a legitimacy crisis from within and without, even as capital continues to flood in; the tension between deployment and caution will define the next phase.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品板块呈现“巨头互撕+硬件涨价”的夏季混战格局。华纳兄弟起诉亚马逊挖角高管，直指加州竞业限制的法律灰色地带；高通计划夏末提价，结合谷歌Pixel 11涨价确认，手机SoC和终端价格即将进入上升通道。Meta在智能眼镜上做出让步，暂时取消Conversation Focus功能的次数限制，显示在隐私争议前的灵活姿态。SpaceX Starship第13次飞行成功结束，计划下次尝试“塔抓”回收，商业航天的工程突破持续惊艳。

- [Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/warner-bros-lawsuit-accuses-amazon-of-illegally-poaching-executives/) ——华纳起诉亚马逊挖角高管，可能重演硅谷竞业禁止争议。
- [Qualcomm is reportedly planning to raise processor prices by the end of the summer](https://www.engadget.com/2223161/qualcomm-planning-to-raise-its-prices/) ——高通提价将直接传导至安卓旗舰机价格，Pixel 11涨价已是前奏。
- [SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/07/25/spacex-eyes-tower-catch-for-next-starship-after-auspicious-end-to-13th-flight/) ——Starship第13飞完美结束，SpaceX计划下一次尝试发射塔回收，向完全可复用迈出关键一步。
- [Meta walks back limits for its smart glasses' Conversation Focus feature, for now](https://www.engadget.com/2223212/meta-walks-back-rate-limits-for-smart-glasses-conversation-focus/) ——Meta暂时取消Conversation Focus限制，显示其对隐私批评的快速响应能力。

科技产品市场正经历成本上行与法律摩擦的“挤兑期”，消费者在涨价潮中需要更精明的选择。
科技产品.en:
Consumer tech and media headlines focus on rising hardware costs, legal battles, and regulatory actions. Qualcomm and Google signal price increases for processors and flagship phones. Warner Bros. sues Amazon for poaching executives, and the Boring Company seeks a $20B valuation. Meanwhile, EU targets TikTok over minors' safety.

- [Qualcomm is reportedly planning to raise processor prices by the end of the summer](https://www.engadget.com/2223161/qualcomm-planning-to-raise-its-prices/) — Android device makers may face higher component costs soon.
- [Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971041/google-confirms-pixel-11-price-hike) — RAM supply issues due to AI data center demand are a factor.
- [Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/warner-bros-lawsuit-accuses-amazon-of-illegally-poaching-executives/) — Renews debate on enforceability of term employment agreements in California.
- [Elon Musk’s Boring Company reportedly raising funding at a $20 billion valuation](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/elon-musks-boring-company-reportedly-raising-funding-at-a-20-billion-valuation/) — Tunneling startup eyes a major round despite mixed track record.
- [EU says TikTok hasn't done enough to ensure minors' safety](https://www.engadget.com/2223242/eu-says-tiktok-hasnt-done-enough-to-ensure-minors-safety/) — Possible fine of up to 6% of annual revenue.

**Signal:** Consumers and businesses alike should brace for higher tech costs, while the legal and regulatory net tightens around Big Tech's labor and privacy practices.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
HackNews今日热门呈现“硬核技术+地缘政治”的混合风味。DeepSeek内部会议录音泄露引发热议，创始人梁文锋关于中美算力差距的评论导致其暂停融资，Hacker News上113分、76条评论揭露了中国AI初创在信息管控与资本扩张之间的脆弱平衡。JetZero的混合翼身客机概念获得94分，代表社区对航空创新的持续关注。此外，ESP32自制桌面飞机雷达、美国高尔夫球场地图等“小而美”项目也展示了社区动手精神。

- [DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript)](https://github.com/demo-zexuan/liang-wenfeng-investor-meeting-2026-7-22/blob/master/%E6%A2%81%E6%96%87%E9%94%8B%E6%8A%95%E8%B5%84%E8%80%85%E4%BA%A4%E6%B5%81%E4%BC%9A-%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E7%A8%BF_1_18_translate_20260723201651.pdf) ——DeepSeek融资暂缓，泄露内容显示中国AI对美硬件依赖的直言不讳。
- [JetZero](https://www.jetzero.aero/) ——混合翼身布局概念引发讨论，航空减碳的工程设计思路。
- [An ESP32 based plane radar for my desk](https://blog.ktz.me/esp32-plane-radar/) ——用ESP32自制桌面飞机雷达，典型的Hacker精神。
- [Show HN: I mapped every US golf course – 16k+ courses, free, no signup](https://golfcoursebrowser.com/) ——利用OSM数据构建全美高尔夫球场地图，展示了开源数据+个人项目的力量。

社区今日的最强信号来自DeepSeek事件：它提醒我们，AI竞赛不仅发生在算法层面，更依赖硬件供应链和政治容忍度。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community features a mix of deep scientific discussions, DIY hardware projects, and industry leaks. Highlights include human evolution research, JetZero's innovative aircraft design, a clever ESP32 plane radar, and a massive dataset of US golf courses. The leaked DeepSeek transcript sparks debate on China-US AI compute rivalry.

- [Humans Haven't Stopped Evolving](https://www.harvardmagazine.com/research/harvard-human-evolution-genes-selective-pressure) — Harvard research shows ongoing selective pressure on human genes.
- [JetZero](https://www.jetzero.aero/) — A blended-wing aircraft concept gaining traction (94 points, 68 comments).
- [An ESP32 based plane radar for my desk](https://blog.ktz.me/esp32-plane-radar/) — A maker project that visualizes aircraft in real-time on a small display.
- [Show HN: I mapped every US golf course – 16k+ courses, free, no signup](https://golfcoursebrowser.com/) — A practical tool built using OpenStreetMap data.
- [DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript)](https://github.com/demo-zexuan/liang-wenfeng-investor-meeting-2026-7-22/blob/master/%E6%A2%81%E6%96%87%E9%94%8B%E6%8A%95%E8%B5%84%E8%80%85%E4%BA%A4%E6%B5%81%E4%BC%9A-%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E7%A8%BF_1_18_translate_20260723201651.pdf) — Leaked transcript reveals candid assessment of China's AI compute disadvantage, leading to fundraising pause.

**Signal:** The community is equally captivated by fundamental science and practical engineering, while the DeepSeek leak underscores the high-stakes geopolitical dimension of AI development.

足球.zh:
今天欧洲转会市场异常活跃，多笔交易接近完成；曼联中场芒特在季前赛表现抢眼，有望成为滕哈格体系的关键拼图。

- [阿森纳探索签下皇马边锋维尼修斯，同时与热刺后卫罗梅罗传出绯闻](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yw2wqxvjwo) — 若成功，枪手将拥有英超最恐怖的左路攻击线。
- [曼联中场梅森·芒特与新援桑托斯配合默契，两场季前赛贡献关键传威胁，或成中场最后拼图](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpd7e8jw9qqo) — 红魔球迷对新赛季中场创造力重燃希望。
- [凯尔特人即将签下博多格林特前锋卡斯帕·霍格，24小时内体检](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwymjrm0xlwo) — 苏超冠军补强锋线，冲击欧冠资格。
- [伊普斯维奇官方宣布日本国脚前田大然加盟，转会费1000万镑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE0zNC1FMVQzdno1VkZMRG5WUjBjY2pVV2ZNdEVHZk14bkN6ZWVjb28tQThrR3pSdkE0RWJkcWNZOEJWWEpJNHBkZC1RbzNHNEtFRnlJcGVn) — 英超新军继续亚洲市场拓展，前田的速度适合反击战术。
- [水晶宫后卫拉克鲁瓦完成切尔西体检，即将签约](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE52aUdYaXpNeGc5U2xiODN0SEVZVlF2RzVTRzV2cGNwaERfZ0FVaV90dFlhTTE3aEN1aUxkSmJMYzhWLWFfVVdWNUphbHNSZFY0cm55Z253) — 蓝军后防更新换代，拉克鲁瓦有望成为主力中卫。

**收束判断：** 英超转会窗进入关键期，阿森纳若成功引入维尼修斯将改变争冠格局；曼联芒特的状态回升则让中场竞争更加激烈。
足球.en:
The 足球 desk collected a wide array of sports beyond football—including boxing, F1, cycling, darts, and rugby league—reflecting a miscategorisation. The biggest story is Anthony Joshua's dramatic knockout of Kristian Prenga, which now sets up a long-awaited fight with Tyson Fury. In motorsport, Lando Norris took pole for the Hungarian Grand Prix, while Lewis Hamilton struggles with penalties. Tadej Pogacar is on the verge of a fifth Tour de France title, and Luke Littler is chasing a darting record. Football transfer gossip: Arsenal exploring a move for Vinicius Jr., Celtic close to signing Kasper Hogh, and Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha heading to Chile.

- [Joshua knocked down twice as dramatic win sets up Fury fight](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/cgew1lrpgzro) — BBC Sport
- [Norris cautious despite pole as it 'falls apart' for Hamilton](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/cm2gd6gd33go) — BBC Sport
- [Paris awaits as Pogacar poised to join Tour greats with fifth title](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c1d141dl2qro) — BBC Sport
- [Arsenal explore Vinicius Jr move - Sunday's gossip](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yw2wqxvjwo) — BBC Sport
- [Bodo/Glimt's Hogh to have Celtic medical within 24 hours](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwymjrm0xlwo) — BBC Sport

Expect the boxing and motorsport stories to dominate tomorrow’s headlines, with the Hungarian GP and Joshua-Fury negotiations moving quickly.

篮球.zh:
NBA休赛期迎来重磅炸弹，勒布朗·詹姆斯决定加盟费城76人，引发联盟格局巨震；同时姚明昔日豪言重登热榜。

- [詹姆斯宣布加盟费城76人，湖人新援格兰姆斯晒训练照与老詹轨迹相反](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9lN0NpZHpjdnNBaHRqVzRXRmpDcHllWFNwMGVaeHBHZnJJYTJmNUtnRE9CM2lUU2JnMXRHMzRMSTVXcEVKNUtfaklIWlg5aXFVdzRKejNLWUUxSXo4aEdSd0o0RQ) — 詹姆斯联手恩比德，76人瞬间成为总冠军最大热门。
- [姚明豪言17岁能随便打泰森·钱德勒？这话还真不是吹，是有底气的](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE4xbVVtaTdYYkdmdzE1cHlVSEl0bkE2NGZrV2hBTTZzcFNXVjc3VUNhWWhlb1ZZSFl6a0VScXZsOElZU1ZFUGtPVHppWEhBc1YybkRhWWxjbWRIQldiaF9nQ0ZDajVfaWozTjNBdjRjNmN4dw) — 网友翻出姚明早年访谈，讨论其年轻时的统治力。

**收束判断：** 詹姆斯东游后湖人需尽快重建，格兰姆斯或成新核心之一；76人需解决球权分配问题。
篮球.en:
Basketball news in the last 24 hours is limited to just two items, both from Chinese sources. The first is a re-emergence of Yao Ming’s claim that as a 17-year-old, he could easily beat Tyson Chandler—a statement rooted in Yao’s early dominance. The second item is a promotional piece listing official free live-streaming channels for basketball betting. No significant league or transfer news was covered.

The 羽毛球 desk is dominated by coverage of the 2026 China Open. Chinese shuttlers had a strong semi-final day, winning three out of four matches against foreign opponents and securing gold and silver in mixed doubles. Chen Yufei advanced to the women’s singles final, while France’s Toma Junior Popov surprised by reaching his first final. 欧美.zh:
圣迭戈动漫展（SDCC）是今日欧美区的绝对主角。漫威在Hall H一口气放出《复仇者联盟：末日》预告、Ryan Gosling联手Shawn Levy的《恶灵骑士》独立电影（2028年）以及David Jonsson饰演T'Challa儿子、定档2028年底的《黑豹3》。此外Ryan Reynolds以死侍装扮乱入乞求角色，将气氛推向高潮。另一条重量级非漫威新闻是Mike Flanagan版《Carrie》剧集首曝预告，定档10月7日。
- [Ryan Gosling Unveiled As Ghost Rider At Marvel’s Comic-Con Panel](https://deadline.com/2026/07/ryan-gosling-ghost-rider-marvel-comic-con-1237003726/) — 从传闻变现实，高司令入局MCU，话题与票房潜力兼备。
- [‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Trailer Rocks Comic-Con: Doctor Doom Raises Army of Sentinels...](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/avengers-doomsday-new-trailer-comic-con-1236817677/) — 杜姆博士带领哨兵大军对阵复联+神奇四侠+X战警，格局铺得极大。
- [‘Carrie’ Schools Comic-Con With Prime Video Release Date, Trailer...](https://deadline.com/2026/07/carrie-comic-con-prime-video-release-date-trailer-1237003861/) — 现代高中校园暴力的恐怖改编，流媒体竞争加剧。
- [Warner Bros. Sues Amazon, Accusing Company of “Seeking to Pirate Away Employees”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/warner-bros-amazon-lawsuit-pirate-away-employees-pia-barlow-1236656642/) — 华纳起诉亚马逊挖角高层，行业人才争夺白热化。
漫威的“终局之后”叙事通过本次SDCC清晰起来，但粉丝对后续规划（如2027空窗期）仍存谨慎乐观。
欧美.en:
The 欧美 desk saw a flurry of activity from San Diego Comic-Con, with major Marvel announcements dominating the news cycle. Additionally, a political music controversy and a corporate lawsuit added depth to the day's coverage.

- **Marvel's Comic-Con panel** revealed Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/ryan-gosling-ghost-rider-marvel-comic-con-1237003726/)) and David Jonsson as T'Challa's son in *Black Panther 3* ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/black-panther-3-marvel-ryan-coogler-comic-con-1236656570/)), with a 2028 release date. The *Avengers: Doomsday* trailer teased an epic showdown ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/avengers-doomsday-new-trailer-comic-con-1236817677/)).
- **Katy Perry** voiced outrage over the White House using her song in a military TikTok, stating her music is 'for bringing people together' ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/katy-perry-white-house-firework-military-strikes-tiktok-1235598831/)). This could trigger a broader debate about political use of copyrighted music.
- **Tom Holland** admitted some past films were 'sh*t', offering a rare candid moment from a star known for diplomacy ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-admits-some-movies-hard-promote-1237003784/)).
- **Prime Video's *Carrie* series** dropped a trailer and set an October 7 release date, with Mike Flanagan teasing a 'big surprise' ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/carrie-comic-con-prime-video-release-date-trailer-1237003861/)).
- **Coyote vs. Acme** finally screened at Comic-Con after being shelved, with director Dave Green calling the fight worth it ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/coyote-vs-acme-director-lana-condor-public-screening-fans-comic-con-1236821209/)).

The day's news signals a strategic pivot for Marvel, a growing rift between artists and political bodies, and a vindication for shelved projects.

日韩.en:
The 日韩 desk highlighted the KM Chart Awards and dramatic developments in several ongoing K-dramas. The market remains buoyant with high ratings and new premieres.

- **TXT won big** at the KM Chart Awards 2026, taking five awards including Artist of the Year (Daesang) ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857355wpp/winners-of-the-km-chart-awards-kma-2026)). The group's dominance solidifies their position in K-pop.
- **'Agent Kim Reactivated' ended** with a 23.0% rating, the highest of 2026, while new drama 'Love on the Menu' premiered to promising numbers ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857346wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ends-on-no-1-ratings-as-love-on-the-menu-premieres-to-promising-start)).
- **Seo In Guk** faces a career crisis in 'See You at Work Tomorrow!' after going public with his relationship, adding tension to the plot ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857362wpp/seo-in-guk-faces-career-crisis-after-going-public-with-his-relationship-in-see-you-at-work-tomorrow)).
- **Namkoong Min** gets arrested for his wife's kidnapping in 'The Husband', a thriller that continues to escalate ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857295wpp/namkoong-min-is-arrested-for-his-wifes-kidnapping-in-the-husband)).
- **Kim Myung Soo's** disappearance plunges Kang Min Ah into despair in 'Love in Sync', driving the romantic comedy's conflict ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857285wpp/kim-myung-soos-sudden-disappearance-plunges-kang-min-ah-into-despair-on-love-in-sync)).

Korean entertainment continues to captivate domestic audiences with high-stakes narratives and record ratings, while awards cement industry leaders.

微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media is ablaze with celebrity scandals, trending topics, and fan interactions. The platform's viral nature amplifies both controversies and promotional strategies.

- **Singer Li Quanzhe** was accused of seat hogging on a high-speed train, sparking a trending topic and a statement from event organizers ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE55eTk4bUtfSzlPVEpkTzB5Mk9leEVEbWhaUlBnQ3JrQTR3eWxVZ0wyZEJ5RmNkVnlfV2VyU1RmN0MtSklKemtLQlZ3WmZwblUyNWlpX2JDQTRvb19oUFluOU1pRXVCOTRWUHp6eWhqWkVBQUc1Zlo3N2tQSWdFUQ)). Public perception may hinge on evidence.
- **Lu Yuxiao** issued an apology after a social media post accidentally violated industry taboos, the incident quickly exploded on Weibo ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQd1pqYlBwRUNDY2R3eGVRZ25UMy1fRjd6QTVhOHk4SzR5Yll5TDF2czVIVEpwTWc4RXh6eWluWTBRa29VeGE0b1FlMmppNXREVzF3RnA5NTh3bkRuSVUwOUtMUXR2a1RKYjRQcG03VHVYOWJONm5SY21uRzdYUkI1NmcxTQ)). This reflects the high stakes of celebrity online behavior.
- **Wang Junkai's studio** used 'reverse push' by asking fans to stop '催更' (urging updates), which itself became a trending topic and is seen as a clever promo tactic ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11ZXp6eVhwZjFEX09FWEl1YkNRX2xSeWlYd1FwdmdkaVhZM3pBeFVMbHJwZWs3d0hEVzkwUERLczhJME5PVnhaQmZMVlE2ZnFrS0YzSnk5blhmVkdfYUlQd1FwVFNNZmZFYWZqOFZuMlo)).
- **'Ba Ye' (巴爷) trended** as a nickname, sparking widespread curiosity and discussion among netizens ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE94MEk5bnM0QXZCUzJTaVM3akk5OG1heWFTRnFyYzUwREtlc2h4NEk2a0RpY0FoNzViVnZNOVBUdC04TE1FdnZHM0FmaUw0dE5PLUtkcE5NOFN5U1h3OVRzWFZJYnp0N0VEREFJZDR1LVJtZw)).
- **Daily entertainment roundups** highlighted moments like Yang Mi eating lotus seeds at a night market, proving that even mundane celebrity acts can trend ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPMTNlQVAwWk90Z0pFLTY1RlhxRFUtYmx3WXlrMHl0RzJWU2Z1aWxaZ1NpQWhvc0w2OG1fSG1ZWkMzTmpweHpzYmQ1WXl3b3ZDZkxWMW1PblBsQm9TRENRd0t4Zk1ITXM3bDNtU3U2WWthYndKTGsxb2Y4S2RwSVpYUmVqUE5JZlpLeEFaUGIwWGM2LWF1cXJ6UWlhWlZVUjVsOHdTdUZCbV9ZdlF4N0cyWXhCVlI4Y205MWRHSTZ0SjRPUVJsX1FfQ09B)).

- [刘亦菲美国初中班级合照曝光！她是美国人，来中国赚钱很受欢迎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQbW52dTNQMjI3QnhISEhCbWRHVWpXLXlhQlBOdUlJZldhdmdmcVhxaEMyVzVLMDNJMEJ1azdWRC0zek9XbnF6RS1wZDY0ZkZlWlpWczBhNVhxTmlhbDdUYWlmb0o2d3ZzLTJ2dnc4UVMyM2hGSmk2cUVZSDB3MnhZZElGSHhJd201bXdfNVR6ekpEZjI1dHFOdlh5U0ZkcU9OcEtGUDhkd094djg) — 旧照重提背后，是舆论对“国籍与市场”的持续敏感。
- [刷屏热搜!迪丽热巴亮相中国影视之夜,粉裙高定生图封神](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBxY0FfUjUxcEpibG1UeWk3Vm14LVZOWWlra0dTaVdrenRHTVBMdE5VcTVONzlOX29RS2t2TlBIaTlrSXNGSFZMRzlqbGZHdUU3QWFFWWFxQ0U2UUVhVEdLOWhfZFA1U3hpZWdEMzdqR3BRZw) — 高定+生图双重加持，流量女王地位稳固。
- [《功夫女足》：赛场逐梦，传递中国精神](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1KbGtXQzd3QllvWFYydzM3TXRVVmRPZFFLZTJmZGJzNllWdk4yQ0NuZmp4N0pJejF3NWs2Q1BwZE4tNkw2bjl2UlJNMGw5T0E) — 体育题材电影借女排余威宣传，题材红利明显。
- [第十六届中国国际影视动漫版权保护和贸易博览会将在广东举办](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE4xeGVDX2cyaXRsOURHaHdueGc3RUhPbGFLSl9wOGpXdS1mYjNkdWV1cGM3YzJBVjE3UGFWTDZrQU9YcWhjVEVHVGJOX3BTanU4Z3BnTnpsWi1wOTR0bk5mNmtoRQ) — 动漫版权贸易成新增长点。
中国娱乐市场在“流量与价值观”的双重杠杆下摇摆，艺人身份政治与国潮内容的结合正成为新显学。
中国.en:
The 中国 desk covers a mix of celebrity news, sports entertainment, and industry events. Notable stories include a renewed debate over Liu Yifei's nationality, and the rise of racing culture driven by Wang Yibo.

- **Liu Yifei's US middle school photo** resurfaced, prompting discussions about her American citizenship and success in China ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQbW52dTNQMjI3QnhISEhCbWRHVWpXLXlhQlBOdUlJZldhdmdmcVhxaEMyVzVLMDNJMEJ1azdWRC0zek9XbnF6RS1wZDY0ZkZlWlpWczBhNVhxTmlhbDdUYWlmb0o2d3ZzLTJ2dnc4UVMyM2hGSmk2cUVZSDB3MnhZZElGSHhJd201bXdfNVR6ekpEZjI1dHFOdlh5U0ZkcU9OcEtGUDhkd094djg)). The story touches on cultural identity and loyalty.
- **Hao Lei**, long considered low-key, has been exposed as a highly respected actress with both beauty and skill, finally gaining widespread recognition ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1OVTdpQVFENlFiWjJBdWFaSThIbkdfczRuYjBnWDZNZW82eWhIT3ZYN1d6OVNmVklLckFtQ0ZlZ0tKenBYNW1IRk50VlZDWVU)).
- **Wang Yibo** is credited with popularizing Chinese racing, as influencer Yan Chuang criticized other stars for causing chaos at events ([Netease](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBjV3ZmTWVjWGlNRVhjX2FQeVlnSjdJMnRjZXQ1aWMweGtWQTE3aV9lMEIwRjVEYnBJTEJUT0xxR2dXQ3hjbnMwbTk4bGh3cUpsUFlqbw)). This highlights the merging of celebrity fandom and sports.
- **Di Lieba** stunned at the China Film Night event, wearing a pink haute couture gown that generated widespread buzz and praise ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBxY0FfUjUxcEpibG1UeWk3Vm14LVZOWWlra0dTaVdrenRHTVBMdE5VcTVONzlOX29RS2t2TlBIaTlrSXNGSFZMRzlqbGZHdUU3QWFFWWFxQ0U2UUVhVEdLOWhfZFA1U3hpZWdEMzdqR3BRZw)).
- **'Kung Fu Women's Football'** continues to gain traction as a film promoting Chinese spirit and sportsmanship ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1KbGtXQzd3QllvWFYydzM3TXRVVmRPZFFLZTJmZGJzNllWdk4yQ0NuZmp4N0pJejF3NWs2Q1BwZE4tNkw2bjl2UlJNMGw5T0E)).

The Chinese entertainment industry is a tapestry of nostalgia, controversy, and sport, with celebrities constantly navigating public perception and national pride.
